jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
L'opportunité

Développer la plateforme Unity consiste à concevoir, bâtir, tester et maintenir les systèmes qui permettent aux développeur(se)s de livrer et d'exploiter des jeux en direct à grande échelle. L'équipe Diagnostics fait partie de l'organisation LiveOps de Unity et est responsable des données qui indiquent aux créateur(rice)s comment leurs jeux se comportent réellement sur le terrain : rapports de plantage du runtime Unity, télémétrie et observabilité à travers les projets clients, analyses de la santé des produits, ainsi que les surfaces du Tableau de bord Unity qui redonnent ces données aux développeur(se)s.

Nous recherchons un(e) Développeur(se) logiciel Sénior pour se joindre à l'équipe Diagnostics en tant que généraliste à dominante backend. Il/elle va diriger la conception de bout en bout à travers notre pile — ingestion depuis des millions de clients de jeux, Pipelines bâtis sur OpenTelemetry, un lac de données basé sur ClickHouse, et les surfaces de tableau de bord dont dépendent les client(e)s — et collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Data, IAP, Profiler et DevX sur les intégrations qui rendent Diagnostics réellement utile. Notre pile est composée de Go (principalement), Kotlin, TypeScript et C#. Il s'agit d'une petite équipe autonome où le jugement sénior a un impact exponentiel : il/elle va définir la manière dont l'équipe conçoit, révise et livre ses solutions, y compris la façon dont nous utilisons les outils d'IA agentique comme partie intégrante de notre pratique de développement.

Ce que vous allez faire

Diriger la conception de bout en bout pour l'ingestion, les Pipelines, le stockage et les requêtes ClickHouse, ainsi que les tableaux de bord sur lesquels les développeur(se)s s'appuient.
Rédiger et maintenir des services Go de haute qualité capables de gérer à grande échelle des entrées contrôlées par des acteurs malveillants, avec une attention particulière à la fiabilité, à la performance et à la clarté des contrats de données.
Rehausser les standards de revue de code et de revue de résultats assistés par l'IA — définir les normes utilisées par l'équipe lorsqu'elle livre des travaux en collaboration avec des agents de codage.
Collaborer avec les différentes équipes (Data, IAP, Unity Profiler, DevX, Analytics) afin de concevoir des intégrations robustes en conditions de production et adaptées aux besoins réels des client(e)s.
Encadrer les développeur(se)s de l'équipe, partager largement les bons modèles, et décomposer des problèmes ambigus en parcours concrets maximisant la valeur.

Ce que nous recherchons

Avoir une expérience en production avec Go dans des services à haut débit, ainsi qu'une aisance sur un large éventail de tâches backend (ingestion, Pipelines, stockage et requêtes OLAP/colonnaires, tableaux de bord au besoin).
Démontrer un jugement de niveau sénior : avoir mené des conceptions transversales, rehaussé le niveau de développement, et mentoré les pairs et collaborateur(rice)s individuel(le)s autour de soi.
Posséder une réelle expérience pratique des flux de travail avec IA agentique : avoir utilisé des agents de codage (Claude Code, Codex, mode agent de Cursor, Gemini CLI ou équivalent) sur du travail concret, développé une opinion éclairée sur leurs compromis, et conçu des harnais, prompts ou sous-agents robustes face à la variance. Revoir les sorties de modèles avec la même rigueur que des revues de PR, et être capable de défendre chaque ligne de code en ses propres mots.
Avoir de l'expérience en conception et en interrogation de magasins de données NoSQL ou OLAP/colonnaires (ClickHouse est un atout), ainsi qu'une compréhension pratique de bout en bout des Pipelines de données.
Posséder d'excellentes aptitudes de collaboration et de communication, avec la capacité de travailler efficacement entre plusieurs équipes et fuseaux horaires.

Vous avez peut-être également

Manifester un intérêt sincère ou une expérience en observabilité et télémétrie (OpenTelemetry en particulier) — c'est notre cœur de métier.
Avoir une expérience front-end avec TypeScript et des contributions à des surfaces de type tableau de bord. Le backend est la priorité pour ce rôle; les compétences front-end sont un atout bienvenu, sans être une attente quotidienne.
Avoir une expérience en production avec Kotlin, ou une exposition à C# du côté du moteur.
Posséder un parcours dans le domaine du jeu vidéo — comprendre comment les développeur(se)s consomment les diagnostics, et ce que la performance et le profilage d'un jeu signifient concrètement pour eux/elles.
Adopter des habitudes responsables dans la gestion des données des utilisateur(rice)s : tenir compte des frontières de confiance, de la rétention, de la journalisation hygiénique (aucune donnée personnelle identifiable, aucun jeton, aucun contenu complet de charge utile) et de la modélisation des menaces avant d'implémenter une fonctionnalité.

Information supplémentaire

Le support à la relocalisation n'est pas disponible pour ce poste
Un visa de travail ou un parrainage de l'immigration n'est pas disponible pour ce poste

The opportunity

Developing the Unity platform means designing, building, testing, and maintaining the systems that empower developers to ship and operate live games at scale. The Diagnostics team sits inside Unity's LiveOps umbrella and is responsible for the data that tells creators how their games are actually behaving in the wild — crash reports from the Unity runtime, telemetry and observability across customer projects, product health analysis, and the Unity Dashboard surfaces that put that data back in developers' hands.

We are seeking a Senior Software Developer to join the Diagnostics team as a backend-leaning generalist. You will lead end-to-end design across our stack — ingest from millions of game clients, pipelines built on OpenTelemetry, a ClickHouse-based data lake, and the dashboard surfaces customers depend on — and you will partner closely with the Data, IAP, Profiler, and DevX teams on the integrations that make Diagnostics useful. Our stack is Go (primary), Kotlin, TypeScript, and C#. This is a small, autonomous team where senior judgment compounds: you will shape how the team designs, reviews, and ships, including how we work with agentic AI tools as a core part of the craft.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead end-to-end design across ingest, pipelines, ClickHouse storage and query, and the dashboards developers rely on.
Write and maintain high-quality Go services that handle attacker-controlled inputs at scale, with strong attention to reliability, performance, and clean data contracts.
Raise the bar on code review and AI-assisted output review — set the norms the team uses when shipping work alongside coding agents.
Partner across teams (Data, IAP, Unity Profiler, DevX, Analytics) to design integrations that hold up under real production load and real customer needs.
Mentor engineers across the team, share patterns broadly, and decompose ambiguous problems into the highest-value path forward.

What We're Looking For

Production experience with Go in high-throughput services, plus comfort moving across a backend-leaning generalist surface (ingest, pipelines, OLAP/columnar storage and query, dashboards when needed).
Demonstrated senior-level judgment: a track record of leading cross-cutting design, raising the engineering bar, and mentoring peers and ICs around you.
Real, hands-on fluency with agentic AI workflows — you have used coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor agent mode, Gemini CLI, or similar) on real work, formed informed opinions about their trade-offs, and built harnesses, prompts, or sub-agents that hold up under variance. You review model output as rigorously as PR code, and can defend any line of it in your own words.
Experience designing for and querying NoSQL or OLAP/columnar data stores (ClickHouse a plus), and a working understanding of data pipelines end to end.
Excellent collaboration and communication, with the ability to work effectively across teams and time zones.

You might also have

Genuine interest or experience in observability and telemetry (OpenTelemetry especially) — this is our bread and butter.
Front-end experience with TypeScript and contributions to dashboard-style surfaces. Backend is the primary lens for this role; front-end capability is a welcome bonus, not a daily expectation.
Production experience with Kotlin, or C# exposure on the engine side.
Gaming background — context for how developers consume diagnostics, what game performance and profiling actually mean to them.
Habits around handling user data responsibly: thinking about trust boundaries, retention, hygienic logging (no PII, no tokens, no full payloads), and threat-modeling features before writing them.

Additional Information

Relocation support is not available for this position
Work visa/immigration sponsorship is not available for this position

Avantages

Chez Unity, nous voulons que nos membres d’équipe s’épanouissent. Nous offrons un large éventail d’avantages conçus pour soutenir le bien-être et l’équilibre travail-vie personnelle.

Veuillez noter: L’admissibilité aux avantages, les offres spécifiques et la couverture varient selon le pays et le statut d’emploi.

Bien que les avantages précis puissent varier, voici certaines des façons dont nous nous efforçons de prendre soin de nos membres d’équipe admissibles à l’échelle mondiale : assurance santé, vie et invalidité complète | Subvention pour les déplacements | Participation des employés à l’actionnariat | Régimes de retraite/pension compétitifs | Vacances et congés personnels généreux | Soutien aux nouveaux parents grâce à des congés et des programmes de soutien aux familles | Collations offertes au bureau | Programmes et soutien en matière de santé mentale et de bien-être | Groupes-ressources pour employés | Programme mondial d’aide aux employés | Programmes de formation et de perfectionnement | Programme de bénévolat et de jumelage de dons

La vie chez Unity

Unity [NYSE : U] est le premier moteur de jeu au monde, propulsant les expériences de plus de 3 milliards d’utilisateurs(rices) chaque mois. Les plus grands jeux mobiles, les titres indépendants PC les plus populaires, des jeux console parmi les plus innovants, ainsi que la quasi-totalité des principales expériences XR et jeux Web sont développés, déployés et optimisés avec Unity.

Unity accompagne également des équipes dans des secteurs tels que l’automobile, l’industrie manufacturière et la santé pour concevoir, simuler et collaborer en 3D - comblant ainsi l’écart entre les idées et la réalité. Pour plus d’informations, veuillez visiter www.unity.com.

Unity est un employeur fier de garantir l’égalité des chances. Nous nous engageons à favoriser un environnement inclusif et innovateur et à célébrer nos employés à travers l’âge, l’éthinicité, la couleur, l’ascendance, l’origine nationale, la religion, le handicap, le sexe, l’identité ou l’expression de genre, l’orientation sexuelle ou tout autre statut protégé conformément à la loi applicable. Si vous êtes en situation de handicap ou avez des besoins spécifiques nécessitant des aménagements pour que votre entretien se déroule dans les meilleures conditions, nous vous invitons à remplir ce formulaire afin de nous en informer et que nous puissions faire le nécessaire.

This role requires a highly capable architect with demonstrable experience delivering AI solutions end-to-end, operating across major cloud platforms, and defining secure enterprise architectures within complex environments. The position will play a key role in helping our organisation strengthen fraud prevention capabilities through the application of advanced AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and modern security technologies.
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise within the Microsoft security ecosystem, whilst maintaining the ability to integrate and architect solutions involving complementary technologies such as CrowdStrike.

Responsibilities:

Solution & Security Architecture:

Design and develop enterprise-scale security architectures across cloud and hybrid environments.
Lead solution architecture activities from requirements gathering through to implementation and operational handover.
Define security patterns, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps aligned to business objectives.
Ensure solutions meet security, compliance, governance, resilience, and operational requirements.
Collaborate with security operations, engineering, data, and business stakeholders to deliver secure-by-design solutions.

AI & Fraud Prevention:

Architect and deliver AI-powered security and fraud prevention solutions.
Apply Large Language Models (LLMs), generative AI, machine learning, and behavioural analytics to identify, prevent, and investigate fraudulent activity.
Design solutions leveraging AI to enhance threat detection, anomaly identification, user behaviour analysis, and fraud risk mitigation.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend innovative approaches to combat evolving fraud threats.
Support responsible AI adoption, ensuring security, governance, and ethical use of AI technologies.

Security & Technology Leadership:

Provide technical leadership on Microsoft security products and services, including:
Microsoft 365 Security
Microsoft Entra
Microsoft Defender Suite
Microsoft Purview
Microsoft Security Copilot
Design integrations between Microsoft security services and third-party platforms, including CrowdStrike.
Support incident response, threat modelling, security assessments, and security transformation initiatives.
Advise stakeholders on security architecture best practice and emerging industry trends.

About You

Significant experience in a Security Architect or Solution Architect role.
Strong solution architecture capability across major cloud platforms (Azure, AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform).
Demonstrable end-to-end delivery experience of AI-enabled solutions in enterprise environments.
Experience designing secure architectures involving machine learning, generative AI, and LLM technologies.
Strong understanding of enterprise security architecture principles, frameworks, and best practices.
Experience translating business requirements into scalable and secure technology solutions.
Knowledge of identity and access management, data protection, threat detection, and security operations.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.
Experience working within complex, regulated environments.

Highly Desirable:

Experience within fraud, fraud prevention, financial crime, behavioural analytics, or risk management domains.
Demonstrable experience using AI and LLMs to reduce fraud risk and improve fraud detection capabilities.
Knowledge of behavioural fraud detection techniques and user/entity behaviour analytics (UEBA).
Experience integrating AI-driven fraud prevention capabilities into enterprise security architectures.
Familiarity with Microsoft Security Copilot and AI-assisted security operations.
Experience with CrowdStrike Falcon and associated security tooling.

Document code, processes and methodologies to ensure maintainability and knowledge sharing within the team.
Lead and participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to peers.

Required Skills And Qualifications

Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, or equivalent experience gained through several years in a relevant role.
Proven experience as an AI developer or engineer, with a strong portfolio of delivered projects.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python and TypeScript.
Working knowledge of Git and version control.
Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software design principles.
Familiarity with data manipulation and analysis tools such as Pandas, NumPy, and SQL.
Experience across the Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages and Dataverse, together with solution management, environments and application lifecycle management.
Experience building and orchestrating LLM agents, including prompt design, grounding and retrieval, structured outputs, and testing and evaluating agent behaviour where outputs are uncertain or non-deterministic.
Experienced with cloud solutions, including how they are run, costed and used.
Experience integrating AI tools with enterprise systems through APIs, including Graph, REST, SQL, SharePoint and dedicated business systems.
Experience working within enterprise guardrails, including AI risk assessment, information security review, data loss prevention, environments and licensing.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and in a team environment.
Strong communication skills, including senior stakeholder management and the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Copilot Studio, or another agent orchestration platform.
Experience mentoring developers or providing technical oversight to a delivery team.
Front end, user experience or product design exposure that signals an awareness of user considerations.
Knowledge of containerisation technologies like Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes.

Opportunities for professional growth and development.

Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
FDM is a global business and technology consultancy seeking a API Platform Lead to work for our client within the Financial Services sector. This is initially a 6-12 month contract with the potential to extend and will be a hybrid role that will be based in Edinburgh.

Our client is seeking a Platform Engineering Lead to own the strategy, engineering, governance, and operation of critical enterprise platforms, with a particular focus on API and integration capabilities.

This role will lead the evolution of a global API platform, enabling secure, scalable, and reusable services across multiple product and engineering teams. The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise with strong engineering leadership experience and a proven track record of delivering enterprise-wide platform transformation initiatives.

Responsibilities:

Platform Ownership

Own the strategic direction, roadmap, and operational performance of the enterprise API platform.
Lead the design, build, operation, and continuous improvement of scalable, resilient, cloud-native platforms.
Ensure platform capabilities are reusable and consumable across global engineering teams.
Drive platform adoption, developer experience, engineering standards, and governance across the organisation.
Establish platform reliability, security, scalability, and disaster recovery standards.

API Platform Leadership

Lead the enterprise API platform strategy and operating model.
Own API lifecycle management including design, development, governance, security, versioning, monitoring, and decommissioning.
Define and implement API standards, design patterns, and best practices across multiple engineering teams.
Build and maintain API management capabilities including developer portals, API gateways, security controls, and consumption frameworks.
Enable federated API development across engineering teams while maintaining enterprise governance standards.

Engineering Leadership

Lead globally distributed software engineering teams and engineering managers.
Build high-performing engineering teams through coaching, mentoring, and leadership.
Drive modern engineering practices including DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, and Agile delivery methods.
Manage relationships with third-party suppliers, technology partners, and offshore delivery providers.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.

Stakeholder Management

Partner with senior technology and business stakeholders to align platform strategy with organisational priorities.
Influence architecture, technology strategy, and digital transformation initiatives.
Communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Manage competing priorities while delivering measurable business outcomes.

About You

Significant experience leading Enterprise Platform Engineering, Platform Operations, or API Engineering functions.
Proven experience owning and managing a large-scale enterprise API platform.
Hands-on experience with Azure API Management (Azure APIM), including platform design, governance, lifecycle management, security, developer enablement, and platform operations.
Strong Azure cloud experience and delivery of cloud-native platforms.
Experience establishing API strategies, standards, governance models, and reusable platform capabilities across large engineering organisations.
Demonstrable experience delivering digital transformation and platform modernisation programmes.
Strong understanding of:
API Architecture
Microservices Architecture
Integration Platforms
Middleware Technologies
Cloud Technologies
Platform Engineering
Identity & Access Management
Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams.
Strong stakeholder engagement and executive communication skills.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will be able to demonstrate:
Ownership and leadership of an enterprise API platform, ideally leveraging Azure API Management (APIM), including strategy, governance, standards, platform operations, and adoption across a large engineering organisation.

About Us

FDM is an award-winning global leader in tech and business talent solutions, backed by more than 35 years of industry experience. We have centres across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific, and a global workforce of over 2500 employees. FDM has shown exponential growth throughout the years, firmly establishing itself as an award-winning employer, currently listed on the FTSE4Good Index and as a 2026 Financial Times UK ‘Best Employer’.

Diversity and Inclusion

FDM Group is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other status protected by federal, provincial or local laws.

Why join us

Career coaching, mentoring and access to upskilling throughout your entire FDM career
Assignments with global companies and opportunities to work abroad
Opportunity to re-skill and up-skill into new areas, develop non-linear career paths and build a skillset within your field
Annual leave and work-place pension

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced engineer to help build and shape the user experience for our identity recovery product that protects organizations when it matters most. You will own the browser-based administration console and desktop application, drive UX improvements across complex recovery workflows, and play a key role in evolving the product toward a modern SaaS platform. You will integrate AI capabilities into both the product and your development process and work closely with product leaders and engineers to deliver software that protects organizations worldwide against identity-based threats.

Your home base is the Netwrix Identity Recovery team. You will work within a shared engineering platform and technology stack, with opportunities to contribute to other products across the Netwrix ITDR portfolio — such as PingCastle, Threat Prevention, and Threat Manager.

Key Responsibilities

Build and maintain the web-based administration console for Netwrix Identity Recovery, creating intuitive and performant UX for complex enterprise recovery workflows

Own real-time notification and status update experiences in the browser, keeping administrators informed during long-running recovery operations
Own authentication and account management UI: login flows, MFA enrollment, and session management
Contribute to the backend services layer to support new UI features — this role requires full-stack capability beyond the UI
Integrate data and capabilities with Netwrix's cybersecurity product platform and other ITDR products
Drive the evolution of the product's UI toward a modern SaaS and cloud-hosted architecture
Promote and optimize the use of AI tools and capabilities to accelerate Netwrix product development
Partner with customers and customer-facing teams to triage and address issues, understand customer needs, and gather feedback on product features
Collaborate across functions with product management, platform and product teams, and engineering leadership to align technical direction with business needs
Help foster a culture of innovation, security-first thinking, mentorship, professional growth, and technical excellence

Qualifications

Required Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience
4+ years of software development experience with a focus on enterprise software
Production experience with C# and .NET in a web application context
Production experience with ASP.NET Core Blazor or a comparable component-based web framework (React, Angular, Vue.js)
Experience designing and delivering on-prem or SaaS software at scale
Understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring/observability

Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in C# and the .NET ecosystem (.NET Core/.NET)

jobs.description:
PANDORA’s Digital & Technology Hub in Warsaw
is a key part of the world’s largest jewellery brand, supporting millions of people in expressing their emotions through meaningful jewellery. As one of our fast-growing global locations, the Warsaw Hub plays a vital role in driving digital innovation, delivering scalable technology solutions and supporting our global transformation journey. Our teams work closely with colleagues across the globe, including our headquarters in Copenhagen, to shape the future of digital in retail and e-commerce.

Behind every great experience at Pandora is a robust digital foundation. Our engineering teams build and connect the systems that power our global ecosystem. You will join a dynamic environment where innovation meets reliability, and every integration is crafted with care. We value creative problem-solving, collaboration, and continuous improvement—ensuring equitable opportunities for all.

We’re proud of our inclusive, people-first culture, guided by our values: We Care, We Dream, We Dare, We Deliver.

Role Summary

The Engineer is a delivering member of a GOPT (Omni Operations Product Line) product team. You will build and support the integration solutions that keep Pandora's supply chain and distribution systems running, working within the technical direction set by your Lead Engineer and inside the agreed architecture and engineering standards. You will need good communication skills to work with your team, product colleagues and business analysts.

You will help deliver quality automated CI/CD pipelines, from requirements through test and behaviour driven development, whilst maintaining operational stability and high coding standards, together with supporting quality deployments, monitoring of the tech stack and overall production health.

The main outcome for this role is dependable delivery — well-tested, well-documented code shipped with minimal disruption to the business — and steady growth towards owning larger pieces of work independently. You will be part of our engineering chapter and will contribute to a DevSecOps culture towards build and run.

Key accountabilities

System design and architecture

Contribute to the design of integration solutions using .NET technologies and event-driven architecture, working to the technical approach set by the Lead Engineer and within the agreed architecture blueprint
Work with cross-functional colleagues (product management, architects, business analysts) to understand business requirements and translate them into technical tasks
Raise design questions, risks and unknowns early rather than resolving them alone

Integration development

Develop and implement .NET-based integration components under the technical direction of a Senior or Lead Engineer, ensuring correct data flow across platforms, systems and applications
Write automated, reusable, testable and efficient code, applying Pandora engineering standards for performance, security and scalability
Participate actively in pair programming and code review — both submitting your work and reviewing the work of peers
Write and maintain unit and integration tests within the team's automated testing frameworks
Maintain technical documentation for the components you build — integration mappings, API specifications and troubleshooting notes
Identify opportunities to simplify or improve existing integrations and propose them to the team

Deployment and operations support

Prepare and execute deployments of your changes into non-production environments, and support production deployments alongside a more senior engineer
Provide post-deployment support and monitoring; join the on-duty engineering roster once onboarded, with a defined escalation path to Senior and Lead Engineers
Investigate and resolve incidents and defects affecting the components you work on, escalating promptly when an issue crosses system boundaries

Security and compliance

Apply Pandora's secure coding practices by default — parameterised data access, input validation, no hardcoded secrets, least-privilege service configuration
Ensure changes comply with security standards, privacy regulations and company policies; raise anything unclear with the Lead Engineer or Information Security rather than working around it
What is needed to succeed
2+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, or a strong graduate profile with demonstrable project work
Working knowledge of one or more of the following: C#, .NET, JSON
Familiarity with REST APIs, web services and integration concepts; exposure to event-driven architecture and messaging platforms such as Kafka or Solace is an advantage
Practical experience with version control, automated testing and CI/CD tool chains
Exposure to supply chain, warehouse or logistics execution systems is an advantage rather than a requirement — domain knowledge is expected to be built on the job
Understanding of Agile delivery and a willingness to work in a build-and-run team model, including an on-duty rotation
Curiosity, and the willingness to ask for help early and to act on review feedback
English (business fluent)

Stable employment based on an employment contract with 3-month probation period- Hybrid work model (onsite from our office on Domaniewska 28 street) - minimum 6 days per month- Free parking for employees regardless of position (reservation required),
Flexible working hours
Support for professional competence development

jobs.title: Senior Software  AI Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Software AI Engineer to join a high-impact, AI-augmented modernization initiative for a leading global asset management firm. In this role, you will help modernize a mission-critical estate of 149 production applications using cutting-edge agentic AI coding workflows, specification-driven analysis, and automated remediation pipelines. The portfolio is predominantly C# / .NET and Python, with Angular, WPF/WCF frontends, SQL Server backends, and internal APIs. Working alongside senior London-based consultants, you will build and drive an advanced AI pipeline designed to improve existing codebases, lift automated test coverage past 70%, clear security vulnerabilities (CVEs), and migrate services to the cloud via GitHub Actions.

Responsibilities

Spec-Driven Insights & Agentic Diagnostics: Apply cutting-edge spec-driven approaches and agentic AI tooling (Copilot agent mode, internal client LLMs, Cursor, Windsurf, or Claude Code) to analyze code health, perform deep-dive assessments, and triage defects at scale.
Vulnerability Remediation: Validate and fix pre-identified security vulnerabilities, execute dependency upgrades, and resolve SAST/DAST/CVE findings to pass quality gates into modern delivery platforms.
Test Engineering & Quality Hardening: Build out functional, integration, and end-to-end test suites using AI tooling, replacing ineffective tests with high-confidence automated suites to reach 70%+ coverage.
Pipeline Extension & BAU Scaling: Enroll additional portfolio services into the standing agentic analysis and remediation pipeline while continuously refining the pipeline's automation patterns.
Extended Architectural Analysis: Perform deep architectural evaluations for flagship codebases exceeding 500k LoC to formulate targeted analysis and refactoring strategies.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with London-based onsite consultants, business stakeholders, and technical teams to validate findings, prioritize backlogs, and align on remediation goals.

Requirements

General Engineering & Legacy Experience: Strong general software engineering background with proven ability to navigate, understand, and contribute production-quality changes across under-documented legacy codebases.
Agentic AI & LLM Proficiency: Demonstrated, hands-on experience using LLMs in software engineering settings to drive agentic coding workflows, generate tests, and remediate non-trivial code at scale.
Testing Discipline: Genuine test engineering mindset—writing high-confidence tests by default and differentiating between raw line coverage and true functional confidence.
Autonomy & Communication: High autonomy with a pragmatic, get-it-done attitude; fluent written and spoken English with clear technical communication capabilities.
Location: Based in Poland, comfortable working in a hybrid model (3 days per week in-office) with regular collaboration across Poland and London teams.

Nice to have

Core Tech Stack Experience: Production experience with C# / .NET (.NET Framework to .NET 6/8 modernization, WPF/WCF replacement) and/or Python.
Spec-Driven & Pipeline Tooling: Exposure to specification-driven AI tools (e.g., JUXT's Allium or GitHub's spec-kit) or experience building repeatable code-analysis pipelines.
Security & CI/CD: Practical experience with CVE triage, dependency upgrades, SAST/DAST tools, and enterprise CI/CD platforms (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy).
Domain Knowledge: Prior experience in financial services, asset management, or other heavily regulated enterprise environments.

We offer

Opportunity to work on bleeding-edge projects
Work with a highly motivated and dedicated team
Competitive salary
Flexible schedule
Benefits package - medical insurance, sports
Corporate social events
Professional development opportunities
Well-equipped office

Fusing technical vision with business acumen, we solve the most pressing technical challenges and enable positive business outcomes for enterprise companies undergoing business transformation. A key differentiator for Grid Dynamics is our 8 years of experience and leadership in enterprise AI, supported by profound expertise and ongoing investment in data, analytics, cloud & DevOps, application modernization and customer experience. jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer - Internal Developer Platform
jobs.description:
About Frontiers

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world's largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers.

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organization at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society. To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video.

The Mission

At Frontiers, we are rewriting the rules of scientific publishing. To support our scale, we are transforming our Engineering Platform into a state-of-the-art Internal Developer Platform (IDP) built on modern principles and AI-augmented workflows — with a North Star of evolving it into an Agentic Development Platform (ADP) where human engineers and AI agents build software side by side, safely and at scale.

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer
— Internal Developer Platform
to help build and run that platform and the AI-First Delivery capabilities on top of it. This is the modern evolution of the DevOps Engineer role: you won't run a ticket queue — you'll treat the platform as a product, own a capability area end to end, and ship the golden paths, guardrails and automation that let our Stream-Aligned Teams (and their agents) deliver faster and more safely. You'll work closely with our Platform Product Manager and Senior Cloud Architect — turning platform strategy and prioritised needs into working capabilities.

The Technical Context

You will build and operate the capabilities that make up the IDP.

Core Stack: Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes (AKS), containers (Docker); services in C#/.NET and Node.js
IaC & GitOps: Terraform, Helm, and a move toward GitOps with ArgoCD
CI/CD: Evolution from Azure DevOps toward GitHub Actions, modernizing pipelines (not a blind "lift and shift")
Integration: Azure API Management, Apollo Federation/GraphOS, n8n
Security: Azure Entra ID, SonarQube, Azure Policy, Key Vault
Observability: NewRelic and Grafana (proactive SRE and business-value metrics)
Developer Experience & AI: Backstage, our Technology Framework (policies/standards as executable AI context), MCP, and AI-driven development (e.g. Cursor AI, GitHub Spec-Kit)

What You'll Do

Build and operate the IDP: golden paths, self-service templates, the developer portal (Backstage) and IDP catalog, and guardrails that keep teams compliant by default (guardrails, not gates)
Own CI/CD and GitOps: GitHub Enterprise and GitHub Actions; help drive the migration off Azure DevOps; implement GitOps (ArgoCD) for AKS — rethinking deployments rather than lifting-and-shifting custom tasks
Provision cloud infrastructure as code: evolve Azure (AKS, networking, databases, APIM, Key Vault, Entra ID) with Terraform and Helm; manage reliability and cost (FinOps)
Improve observability & reliability: instrument systems (NewRelic, Grafana), define SLOs, reduce operational toil, and drive monitoring-cost accountability
Advance AI-First Delivery and the ADP: build agent-ready context (MCP, the Technology Framework), path definitions (e.g. validate-change, PR-review), and agent governance (non-human identity, sandboxed execution, evaluation, agent observability)
Own a capability area end to end and set the standard: take a platform domain (e.g. CI/CD & GitOps, or cloud foundations) from design to run, define the reference patterns and ADRs others build on, and raise the bar through code review, mentoring and pairing
Build for adoption, like a product: design capabilities around real internal customers, write docs that work, and gather feedback from the teams you serve — so the platform is genuinely the easiest, safest path. Partner with the Platform Product Manager on priorities, and let adoption, DORA and DevEx metrics (not ticket counts) tell you what to improve next

Requirements

A full-stack software engineering background (prerequisite): you've built and shipped production software yourself (e.g. in C#/.NET, Node.js, Python, Go or similar) — so you bring genuine developer empathy for the engineers you build the platform for, and you design self-service that you'd actually want to use
Senior-level experience: typically 5+ years building and operating cloud platforms or infrastructure, including owning a capability area end to end and setting patterns / mentoring other engineers
Cloud & Kubernetes: strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure (AWS/GCP transferable) and Kubernetes (AKS): networking, storage, managed databases
Infrastructure as Code & GitOps: Terraform and Helm; GitOps with ArgoCD or similar
CI/CD: modern pipelines (GitHub Actions ideal); experience migrating from other CI systems a plus
Observability & reliability: metrics/logs/traces, SLOs and error budgets; security/compliance as code (policy-as-code, secrets management, identity basics)
Product mindset for internal tooling: developer empathy, self-service design, guardrails not gates
AI-First: you already work with AI coding assistants (e.g. Cursor) and are excited to build golden paths and agent workflows, not just consume them
Language: Professional-level English (spoken and written)

Nice to Have

API platform experience (Azure APIM, Apollo Federation/GraphOS) and developer-portal experience (Backstage)
Exposure to agentic/LLM tooling, MCP, GitHub Spec-Kit, or building AI developer workflows
Interest or experience in Spec-Driven Development and AI coding assistants
Experience facilitating InnerSource or community-driven platform contributions
Familiarity with Team Topologies, DORA, SPACE / DX Core 4, CNCF platform maturity; workflow automation (n8n) and FinOps

How We Measure Success In This Role

Adoption: teams/services on golden paths; self-service actions; time-to-first-deploy for a new service
Delivery (DORA): deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change-failure rate, time to restore
Developer experience: internal NPS/satisfaction, support-ticket trend, golden-path coverage
Reliability & cost: SLOs met; cloud and monitoring spend under control

Why This Role Is Exciting

Platform engineering gets more
valuable in the AI era, not less: the platform does :90% of the work, the model :10%. You'll help move engineering effort from one-off delivery toward owning, running and evolving the platform and its agents
— the scarce, high-leverage work of the next decade — all in service of a mission that matters: making science open for everyone.

We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub

Equal opportunity statement

Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination - including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.

jobs.description:
The Role

As a Backend Engineer at our client, you will contribute directly to the core index layer, processing video indexing based on signals from the algorithm team. Your work will power the auto-tagging engine—the system that splits sports games into distinct events and accurately assigns start and end times to each action. You will balance deep feature development with critical problem-solving in a highly collaborative, AI-integrated environment.

About The Product

The product is an AI-powered sports media platform used by major sports organizations to transform live broadcasts into personalized digital content at scale. Every live stream is continuously ingested, analyzed, and enriched with AI-generated metadata, enabling automatic detection of key moments, intelligent video indexing, and near real-time content creation.

Behind the scenes, the platform processes massive volumes of live and archived video 24/7, powering personalized fan experiences across web, mobile, social, and broadcast channels. The backend infrastructure is built for extreme throughput, low-latency processing, and elastic scaling, combining distributed microservices with production-grade ML inference pipelines to deliver reliable performance under unpredictable traffic peaks.

Team Structure & Collaboration

You will join a focused backend squad consisting of four developers, one QA, and one PM, led by the engineering manager. This squad sits within a larger group of two backend teams and two algorithm teams. jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – NETSUITE ARCHITECT (FIXED TERM CONTRACT - 2 Years)

THE TEAM & THE JOB

The Enterprise Systems NetSuite team owns the support, development and strategic direction of YouGov's NetSuite ERP platform, the system underpinning the company's core finance processes. The team is being reshaped to combine operational analyst support with dedicated architectural capability under the Senior Finance Systems Implementation Manager.

As NetSuite Architect, you will be the expert-level professional providing technical leadership for the platform on a fixed term contract. You will own the overall technical vision and architecture, define the "how" and "what" of solutions on significant and unique issues, and act as the recognised subject matter expert advising senior stakeholders. You will translate the functional vision for the ERP into an architectural plan and guide its execution, maintaining a future-focused approach to scalability, maintainability and long-term platform evolution.

What You Will Be Doing – Key Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end technical vision and architecture for the NetSuite platform, translating business strategy into an architectural roadmap.
Design and architect end-to-end NetSuite solutions, including customisations, integrations and workflows, exercising considerable creativity, foresight and judgment.
Make high-impact technical decisions on integration patterns, customisation approaches and data models, evaluating trade-offs between business needs, intangibles and technical constraints.
Assess and document the existing customised NetSuite landscape (scripts, workflows, forms, integrations) to support future transitions and upgrades.
Architect integrations across multiple systems using SuiteTalk, RESTlets and middleware platforms.
Define and enforce NetSuite development standards, governance policies and best practices across the platform.
Lead complex, enterprise-wide NetSuite initiatives from requirements gathering through deployment and post-go-live support.
Conduct solution design reviews, code reviews and performance optimisation assessments, providing expert technical leadership and mentorship to the wider team.
Advise senior business and functional stakeholders, developing recommendations and persuading diverse audiences on platform decisions and module/third-party evaluation.
Produce comprehensive technical architecture documentation, data models and integration specifications so knowledge is retained beyond the contract term.
Work closely with the Senior Finance Systems Implementation Manager, the Senior NetSuite Analyst, Finance stakeholders and third-party providers, staying current with NetSuite platform updates and industry trends.

What You Need To Know (technical & Behavioural Skills/Competencies)

6–8+ years' hands-on NetSuite experience operating as an architect, with a proven track record of leading full implementation lifecycles as a technical leader.
Experience architecting solutions independently across multiple implementations or complex enterprise-wide projects, in more than one enterprise-sized organisation.
Deep technical expertise across the entire NetSuite platform, including expert knowledge of SuiteScript 2.x (Client, User Event, Scheduled, RESTlets, Map/Reduce) and custom development.
Extensive experience with SuiteFlow, SuiteTalk (SOAP/REST), SuiteAnalytics and SuiteBundler, and a deep understanding of NetSuite data architecture, saved searches and custom records.
Strong understanding of enterprise architecture patterns and experience with integration platforms (Boomi, Celigo, Workato, MuleSoft or similar).
Strong knowledge of accounting principles and ERP business processes (Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Financial Close).
Conceptual thinking to work on significant and unique issues where analysis requires evaluation of intangibles, with independent judgment on methods, techniques and evaluation criteria (be accountable).
Ability to convey complex, non-routine information and persuade diverse senior stakeholders across multiple cultures, frequently advising others on complex matters (communicate clearly).
A collaborative approach to technical leadership, building capability in others rather than holding knowledge (trust each other), and staying current with platform and industry developments (be fast).
NetSuite certifications (Administrator, SuiteFoundation; SuiteCloud Developer II preferred) and ideally architect qualifications such as TOGAF or CSA.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Why join YouGov?

Join our global team to help us achieve our social mission: to make millions of people’s opinions heard for the benefit of our local, national, and international communities.

Understanding diversity of opinion requires diversity of background. Although our global panel of millions of people worldwide powers our research, our biggest asset is our people. If our research is to be truly representative of what the world thinks, we need people from all walks of life to be part of the team to bring their perspective to the work we do.

Life at YouGov

We are driven by a set of shared values. We are fast, fearless, and innovative. We work diligently to get it right. We are guided by accuracy, ethics, and proven methodologies. We respect and trust each other, bringing these values into everything that we do.

We strive to provide YouGovers with best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. We want our employees to have a sense of belonging and uniqueness in a supportive workplace, so they can bring their full selves to work.

Equal Opportunity Employer

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity or expression, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, marital status, age, disability, genetic information, HIV status, political affiliation, socioeconomic background, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law or in line with our responsibilities as a fair and ethic employer. All employment decisions are made based on occupational qualifications, merit, and business need.

jobs.description:
Join us, at Wolters Kluwer, and be part of a dynamic global technology company that makes a difference every day.

We’re innovators with impact. We provide expert software and information solutions that the world’s leading professionals rely on, in the moments that matter most. You’ll make a real difference in the lives of millions of people. Together with our customers, we help to advance sustainability, health, justice, prosperity, and commerce around the world.

You can thrive at Wolters Kluwer, where diversity is core to our collective strength and high performance. Be your unique self, share your creative ideas, do your best work, and take time to grow in our caring and inclusive culture where you can belong.

About This Role

Our team is building a central GenAI Platform to empower hundreds of product teams across the organization with scalable capabilities for rapid development, validation, and deployment of AI agents. We also drive the development of the most impactful AI agents, ensuring faster delivery and greater impact across multiple domains. With over 20 agents already launched and many more in progress, our work accelerates innovation and improves outcomes in critical industries.

You'll join a 100-engineer team within a larger organization that combines the stability of an established company with the agility of a startup. In this high-autonomy, high-impact role, you'll take problems from concept to production. You'll design and ship full-stack systems, shape platform capabilities to empower hundreds of product teams, and directly contribute to the development of the most impactful AI agents.

Flagship Agent: UpToDate Expert AI

In Health, we’re launching UpToDate Expert AI
—a medical research and clinical reasoning agent that transforms the world’s most widely used point‑of‑care knowledge resource into a real‑time medical assistant. Millions of physicians will rely on it to accelerate differential diagnosis, refine treatment decisions, and reduce cognitive load—while maintaining rigorous safety, privacy, and guideline fidelity. Improvements you ship (latency, reliability, hallucination reduction) will translate directly into faster, higher-quality patient care at global scale.

What You’ll Do

Design and implement full‑stack applications, AI agents, and platform components that enable rapid GenAI agent development, validation, and deployment.
Build developer tooling, CI/CD, and observability for safe, fast iteration (evals, canaries, rollout/rollback, cost and quality telemetry).
Apply secure SDLC and privacy‑by‑design practices (threat modeling, least privilege).
Collaborate with product, UX, and domain experts to deliver customer‑focused solutions with measurable outcomes.
Apply current LLM patterns (RAG, retrieval, routing, tool-use, evals) to deliver measurable customer value—faster, more reliable AI systems; reduced time-to-decision; improved trust/safety metrics; and lower cost per query.
Lead by example through writing high-quality, maintainable code that demonstrates engineering craftsmanship.

Minimum Qualifications

5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
Strong full‑stack development skills and cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP).
Expert in at least one, and proficient across the others:
AI Agent development and evaluation
Backend development
Frontend development
Cloud services (AWS/Azure/GCP)
CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
Quality engineering / testing strategy
Secure SDLC and privacy by design

Proven track record delivering secure, reliable, cloud‑native systems to production.
Excellent problem‑solving, ownership, and cross‑functional communication.

Nice to have

Proven ability to deliver software products independently or as part of a small, fast-paced team.
Experience of taking AI agents from concept to production, including safety evaluations, iterative testing (e.g., A/B testing), and continuous improvement.
Experience with LangChain/LangGraph and MCP; vector/RAG systems; OpenSearch.
Worked on traditional ML tasks like training, deployment, and monitoring.
Understand how LLMs work, their failure modes, and techniques like fine-tuning and model adaptation.
Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as SOC2, HIPAA, etc.

Stages

15‑minute intro screen
2× live coding in your preferred language
1× systems design
1× presentation of past work

Timeline:
Typically 2–4 weeks

Your first months

Month 1: Deep-dive into one platform component most aligned with your
expertise; ship small improvements while ramping up.
After onboarding: We’ll align on a high-impact area that fits your strengths
and ambitions.

To apply:

Please submit your resume
along with a brief cover letter
that includes a “Statement of Exceptional Work.”
In your cover letter, highlight one of your most impactful projects by addressing the following:

Your role and the problem space you were working in
The technical and product challenges you faced, and how you addressed them
The measurable impact of your work (e.g., metrics, outcomes, improvements)

This will help us better understand your approach to solving complex problems and the value you bring to the team.

Please do not include any proprietary or confidential information
in your submission

Be the Difference | If making a difference matters to you, then you matter to us.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Senior Software  AI Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Software AI Engineer to join a high-impact, AI-augmented modernization initiative for a leading global asset management firm. In this role, you will help modernize a mission-critical estate of 149 production applications using cutting-edge agentic AI coding workflows, specification-driven analysis, and automated remediation pipelines. The portfolio is predominantly C# / .NET and Python, with Angular, WPF/WCF frontends, SQL Server backends, and internal APIs. Working alongside senior London-based consultants, you will build and drive an advanced AI pipeline designed to improve existing codebases, lift automated test coverage past 70%, clear security vulnerabilities (CVEs), and migrate services to the cloud via GitHub Actions.

Responsibilities

Spec-Driven Insights & Agentic Diagnostics: Apply cutting-edge spec-driven approaches and agentic AI tooling (Copilot agent mode, internal client LLMs, Cursor, Windsurf, or Claude Code) to analyze code health, perform deep-dive assessments, and triage defects at scale.
Vulnerability Remediation: Validate and fix pre-identified security vulnerabilities, execute dependency upgrades, and resolve SAST/DAST/CVE findings to pass quality gates into modern delivery platforms.
Test Engineering & Quality Hardening: Build out functional, integration, and end-to-end test suites using AI tooling, replacing ineffective tests with high-confidence automated suites to reach 70%+ coverage.
Pipeline Extension & BAU Scaling: Enroll additional portfolio services into the standing agentic analysis and remediation pipeline while continuously refining the pipeline's automation patterns.
Extended Architectural Analysis: Perform deep architectural evaluations for flagship codebases exceeding 500k LoC to formulate targeted analysis and refactoring strategies.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with London-based onsite consultants, business stakeholders, and technical teams to validate findings, prioritize backlogs, and align on remediation goals.

Requirements

General Engineering & Legacy Experience: Strong general software engineering background with proven ability to navigate, understand, and contribute production-quality changes across under-documented legacy codebases.
Agentic AI & LLM Proficiency: Demonstrated, hands-on experience using LLMs in software engineering settings to drive agentic coding workflows, generate tests, and remediate non-trivial code at scale.
Testing Discipline: Genuine test engineering mindset—writing high-confidence tests by default and differentiating between raw line coverage and true functional confidence.
Autonomy & Communication: High autonomy with a pragmatic, get-it-done attitude; fluent written and spoken English with clear technical communication capabilities.
Location: Based in Poland, comfortable working in a hybrid model (3 days per week in-office) with regular collaboration across Poland and London teams.

Nice to have

Core Tech Stack Experience: Production experience with C# / .NET (.NET Framework to .NET 6/8 modernization, WPF/WCF replacement) and/or Python.
Spec-Driven & Pipeline Tooling: Exposure to specification-driven AI tools (e.g., JUXT's Allium or GitHub's spec-kit) or experience building repeatable code-analysis pipelines.
Security & CI/CD: Practical experience with CVE triage, dependency upgrades, SAST/DAST tools, and enterprise CI/CD platforms (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy).
Domain Knowledge: Prior experience in financial services, asset management, or other heavily regulated enterprise environments.

We offer

Opportunity to work on bleeding-edge projects
Work with a highly motivated and dedicated team
Competitive salary
Flexible schedule
Benefits package - medical insurance, sports
Corporate social events
Professional development opportunities
Well-equipped office

About Us

Grid Dynamics (NASDAQ: GDYN) is a leading provider of technology consulting, platform and product engineering, AI, and advanced analytics services. Fusing technical vision with business acumen, we solve the most pressing technical challenges and enable positive business outcomes for enterprise companies undergoing business transformation. A key differentiator for Grid Dynamics is our 8 years of experience and leadership in enterprise AI, supported by profound expertise and ongoing investment in data, analytics, cloud & DevOps, application modernization and customer experience. Founded in 2006, Grid Dynamics is headquartered in Silicon Valley with offices across the Americas, Europe, and India.

Project Description:

The project is part of the Credit, Asset-backed & Securitized Products (CASP) division of an investment bank, focusing on platforms that support securitization and structured finance products. The current primary objective is migrating existing on-premise systems to a modern Microsoft Azure cloud environment, transforming legacy architecture into scalable, cloud-native solutions. It involves rebuilding and adapting systems used for structuring, processing, and distributing securities such as ABS, MBS, and CLOs. The platform integrates with trading, risk, and regulatory systems to support both real-time and batch data processing. The target architecture follows a microservices-based approach with containerized services deployed on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Infrastructure provisioning and configuration are managed using Terraform as Infrastructure as Code. The system leverages REST APIs and event-driven communication to ensure scalability and flexibility during and after migration. Special focus is placed on maintaining data consistency, performance, and regulatory compliance throughout the transition. The project emphasizes high availability, resilience, and observability in a complex financial ecosystem. AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot are integrated to enhance engineering productivity. The environment promotes modern engineering practices, automation, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java 11+ and Spring Boot within a microservices architecture.
Build and enhance RESTful APIs and message-driven services supporting securitization and credit workflows.
Develop and deploy cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure, including AKS-based container orchestration.
Use Terraform to define and manage infrastructure as code.
Work with containerization technologies (Docker) and contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitLab or GitHub.
Implement integrations using messaging systems such as Kafka, IBM MQ, or Tibco EMS.
Collaborate on system design, ensuring scalability, resilience, and alignment with distributed architecture principles.
Develop and optimize database interactions using Azure SQL, Oracle, or Sybase.
Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality and reliability.
Implement monitoring, logging, and observability practices to support production systems.
Utilize Linux/Unix skills for troubleshooting and scripting.
Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency while maintaining high coding standards.

Mandatory Skills Description:

Strong object-oriented programming skills with Java 11+
Extensive experience with Spring Boot / Spring ecosystem
Hands-on development of Web and/or REST APIs and message-driven services
Experience building and running containerized applications
Strong experience with Azure cloud, including:
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform
Kubernetes (AKS) and container orchestration
Compute (VMs) and storage solutions (e.g., Azure Files)
Solid Linux/Unix skills (shell scripting, system understanding)
Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) integrated into development workflows
Experience with GitLab / GitHub, IntelliJ / VSCode

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

Microservices architecture and system design
Messaging and integration technologies: Kafka, IBM MQ, Tibco EMS
Relational databases: Azure SQL, Oracle, Sybase
Testing frameworks (unit, integration and E2E testing)
CI/CD pipelines (GitLab / GitHub)
Monitoring and observability practices

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

Vi utmanar de traditionella konsultbolagen och vi kan med stolthet säga att Castra är konsultbranschens mest utvecklande arbetsplats där allt är möjligt. Känns det här som företaget för dig så läs gärna vidare.

Rollen

Vi söker en erfaren Senior .NET-utvecklare med fullstackprofil som vill arbeta med utveckling av moderna och robusta system i tekniskt utmanande miljöer.

I rollen kommer du att ha .NET som din huvudsakliga kompetens och arbeta med både backend- och frontendutveckling. Du blir en viktig del av utvecklingsarbetet och kommer att vara involverad i allt från teknisk analys och design till implementation, testning och vidareutveckling.

Vi söker dig som har ett starkt tekniskt intresse och som trivs med att ta ansvar för hela utvecklingsprocessen. Du har förmågan att förstå komplexa tekniska problem, se helheten och samtidigt arbeta på detaljnivå när det krävs.

Vi har pågående projekt inom bland annat statliga myndigheter där du får möjlighet att arbeta med lösningar som stödjer viktiga verksamhetsprocesser och möter höga krav på kvalitet och stabilitet. I rollen kommer du bland annat att analysera behov och tekniska frågeställningar, utveckla och vidareutveckla funktionalitet samt arbeta med både backend- och frontendlösningar. Du kommer även att bidra i testning, felsökning och vidareutveckling av befintliga system.

Erfarenhet

Minst 7 års erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling, med .NET som huvudsaklig teknisk kompetens.
Erfarenhet av fullstackutveckling med både backend och frontend.
Minst 2 års erfarenhet av React.
Praktisk erfarenhet av cloudmiljöer, exempelvis AWS, Azure eller GCP.
Erfarenhet av Kubernetes och/eller OpenShift.
Erfarenhet av Docker och containerbaserade lösningar.
Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska i tal och skrift.

Meriterande

Erfarenhet av Apache Kafka och eventdriven arkitektur.
Erfarenhet av både privat och offentlig sektor.

Varför ska du välja oss?

Här tror vi på frihet, möjligheter och medbestämmande. Att du som medarbetare ska ha möjlighet att utvecklas och forma ditt arbete utefter dina intressen och prioriteringar i livet. Att alla får vara med och forma och påverka bolaget genom delägarskap, advisory board och projektgrupper. Att det är viktigt att ha ett sammanhang, känna tillhörighet och att man har kollegor som stöttar, utvecklar och tror på en.

Om Castra

Castra är en entreprenörsdriven konsultgrupp inom IT, management och systemutveckling. Bolaget ägs gemensamt av medarbetarna och tillsammans bygger vi det företag vi själva vill jobba på.

Vår vision är att vi ska vara Sveriges bästa arbetsgivare för konsulter. Att vi blivit certifierade av Great Place to Work® fem år i rad är ett bevis på våra höga mål kring företagskultur. Våra tankar om delaktighet, påverkansmöjligheter och respekt för individens egna val och möjligheter fungerar.

Företaget har kontor i Göteborg, Stockholm, Helsingborg, Malmö, Linköping, Norrköping, Örebro och Jönköping. Mer information om Castra-koncernen hittar du på vår hemsida www.castra.se.

We are currently looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to join our Global Applications team in Malmö, Sweden.

In this role, you will take a leading part in developing new applications and enhancing existing solutions used across ASSA ABLOY's global business. You will work with technologies such as .NET, C#, React, TypeScript, SQL, and Microsoft Azure, collaborating with colleagues across multiple countries and functions.

This is an opportunity for an experienced developer who thrives in a hands-on role, enjoys technical ownership, and wants to contribute to the design, development, and future direction of business-critical applications. You will join a collaborative team environment where knowledge sharing, innovation, and continuous improvement are highly valued.

What you will do as our Senior Full Stack Developer

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and improving applications and services that support our global business. You will work closely with colleagues across development, support, and business functions to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-focused solutions.

You would also:

Participate in daily operations and strategic digital transformation initiatives, contributing to the ongoing evolution of our application landscape.
Design, develop, maintain, and enhance applications, services, and platforms using technologies such as Microsoft Azure, .NET, C#, React, TypeScript, SQL, MS Windows, Visual Studio, and related tools.
Develop, maintain, and support application platforms and their underlying infrastructure, ensuring reliability, scalability, performance, and required maintenance activities.
Identify and drive improvement and automation opportunities, taking ownership from idea and solution design through implementation and documentation in line with best practices.
Act as a technical expert and trusted advisor, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders, development teams, business users, and business analysts to translate business requirements into practical solutions.
Architect, design, build, and implement application platforms and services, while delivering new functionality and enhancements for internal customers.
Analyse, troubleshoot, and resolve platform-related issues, coordinate defect resolution across teams, and support the ongoing maintenance, improvement, and documentation of application platforms.

The Skills And Experience You Need

We are looking for someone who has:

At least 5 years of experience in Full Stack Development.
Strong experience with C#, .NET, SQL, and modern application development.
Experience working with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based solutions.
Experience with frontend technologies such as React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
Experience building and consuming APIs and working across the full software development lifecycle, from solution design to deployment.
Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and communicate effectively in English and Swedish.

You are a proactive, structured, and solution-oriented developer who enjoys taking ownership and turning ideas into practical, scalable solutions. You thrive in collaborative environments and are comfortable working closely with developers, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams. Experience working in Agile environments is important, and you bring curiosity, initiative, and a genuine passion for learning new technologies and approaches.

Experience working in enterprise-scale environments, setting up Azure infrastructure and cloud environments, and using tools such as Jira, GitHub, and ServiceNow is considered an advantage. Most importantly, you are someone who can navigate complex technical challenges, balance technical excellence with business needs, and contribute ideas that improve both our technology and the way we work.

Learning and career development opportunities, whether it’s online learning, management training or enhancing your skills.
A competitive salary
Hybrid model of working
Stable employment in a friendly international atmosphere

To ensure that your personal information is secure, we do not review any applications sent via email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, please send an email to Khalil Kabakibi, Talent Acquisition Business Partner, at Khalil.kabakibi@assaabloy.com .

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Loyalty management
jobs.description:
We are super excited to announce that Jimmy Sigwid is looking for our next Staff Software Engineer
to join our Data & Integrations product area and Team Points.

Our mission is to make loyalty, incentives and customer data scalable, reliable and actionable across Voyado’s platform. Behind that mission are systems handling business-critical transactions and data for some of the world’s leading brands — and as Voyado and our customers grow, so do the technical challenges we need to solve.

A key focus going forward is evolving our platform architecture to support greater scale, stronger domain ownership and more independent services. This means working with everything from distributed systems and data consistency to event-driven architecture and service boundaries.

About The Role

The Points team owns the systems behind how consumers earn and use loyalty points and rewards across Voyado’s retail customers. Whether someone earns points from a purchase, uses them towards a reward, or interacts with a loyalty program across different channels, our services help make that experience possible.

These are business-critical systems that need to remain fast, reliable and consistent as transaction volumes and use cases grow.

Right now, the team is in the middle of an exciting technical transition. We are evolving parts of the architecture to handle greater scale, reduce dependencies between domains and make it easier for teams to evolve their services independently. A large part of this means moving towards more event-driven and service-oriented patterns and rethinking how services and data interact.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll be one of the technical drivers behind that evolution. You’ll work hands-on with backend development and distributed systems while helping the team make architectural decisions that need to hold up over time.

The role combines deep technical work with technical leadership. You’ll drive complex initiatives, mentor other engineers and collaborate across teams to improve both our platform and the way we build software.

So, who are you?

We’re looking for an experienced backend engineer who combines strong technical depth with the ability to influence technical direction beyond their immediate team.

You enjoy taking ownership of complex technical problems where the solution isn’t always obvious. You’re comfortable creating clarity, evaluating trade-offs and bringing other engineers along in the direction you propose — while still staying close to the code.

You don’t need experience from our exact stack, but we believe you have worked with several of the following:

Backend development in C#, .NET, Java, Kotlin, Go, or similar
Distributed systems, cloud-native services and event-driven architectures
REST APIs, asynchronous workflows and message-based systems such as Kafka, RabbitMQ or Azure Service Bus
SQL databases, transactional consistency and scalable data handling
Observability, automated testing and secure engineering practices

We also think you:

Enjoy driving technical direction and improving engineering practices
Are comfortable mentoring and supporting other engineers
Can lead technical initiatives that span teams or domains
Use AI coding tools as a natural part of software development and see AI-assisted engineering as an important capability going forward as we continue our journey toward becoming AI-native

Experience with high-volume transactional systems
, such as fintech, payments, loyalty or similar domains, is a strong plus — but previous retail experience is not required.

What's in it for you?

Voyado wouldn’t be the powerful platform it is without the people behind it. We really care for our Voyadoers and some examples of what we can offer you are:

An engaged team with a knowledge-sharing and friendly culture
