Vill du leda ett kompetent utvecklingsteam samtidigt som du driver den tekniska utvecklingen mot moderna, molnbaserade lösningar? Hos Hogia Redovisning & Revision får du en nyckelroll där du kombinerar ledarskap, teknikstrategi och innovation med ett nära samarbete med verksamheten.

Om rollen

Som Engineering Manager har du det övergripande ansvaret för ett utvecklingsteam med ca 10 medarbetare bestående av utvecklare och testare. Ditt främsta fokus är att skapa förutsättningar för teamets framgång genom ett närvarande och utvecklande ledarskap, samtidigt som du leder den tekniska utvecklingen framåt.

Du ansvarar för att driva de strategiskt viktiga teknikfrågorna inom området och säkerställa en hållbar utveckling av våra produkter. Rollen innebär ett stort fokus på modernisering, automation och AI-drivna arbetssätt där du tillsammans med teamet identifierar möjligheter att effektivisera utveckling, kvalitetssäkring och leverans. Du följer aktivt utvecklingen inom teknikområdet, omvärldsbevakar och omsätter relevanta trender till konkreta initiativ som stärker både produkterna och arbetssätten.

En viktig del av uppdraget är att balansera förvaltningen av våra hybrida Core-produkter med den fortsatta utvecklingen av våra molnbaserade lösningar. Du arbetar nära produktledning, kravställare och andra utvecklingsteam för att säkerställa rätt tekniska vägval över tid.

Rollen är huvudsakligen strategisk och ledarskapsorienterad, men beroende på situation och behov kan du även bidra operativt i tekniska frågor eller utvecklingsarbete.

Är du den vi söker?

Vi tror att du har en eftergymnasial utbildning inom systemutveckling eller motsvarande samt flera års erfarenhet av modern systemutveckling. Du har tidigare haft personalansvar eller lett utvecklingsteam och känner dig trygg i att kombinera ett coachande ledarskap med tekniskt beslutsfattande.

Du har erfarenhet av moderna utvecklingsmiljöer och molnbaserade lösningar samt ett intresse för hur automation och AI kan skapa effektivare utvecklingsprocesser och bättre produkter.

Vi arbetar bland annat med: C#, .NET Core, Microservices, Azure DevOps, Git, React, HTML/CSS, SQL, Cosmos DB, C++, MFC, XML

Du behöver inte ha erfarenhet av samtliga tekniker, men du har en bred teknisk förståelse och en vilja att fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med teamet.

Som person är du en trygg och prestigelös ledare som bygger engagemang, tydlighet och samarbete. Du är strukturerad och har förmågan att prioritera, skapa riktning och driva förändring även när flera initiativ pågår samtidigt. Du trivs med att arbeta långsiktigt, har ett genuint intresse för ny teknik och inspireras av att omsätta nya möjligheter till affärsnytta. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på både svenska och engelska och samarbetar naturligt med kollegor, chefer och externa samarbetspartners.

Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Vad vi erbjuder

Hos oss bygger du lösningar som används av tusentals kunder och blir en viktig del av vår resa mot framtidens molnbaserade affärssystem. Du får möjlighet att påverka både teknikval, arbetssätt och teamets utveckling i en organisation som värdesätter innovation, kvalitet och långsiktighet.

Vi erbjuder goda utvecklingsmöjligheter, en hälsosam balans mellan arbete och fritid samt attraktiva förmåner. Vi satsar på hälsa och erbjuder flera träningsaktiviteter, möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån ett par dagar i veckan och en arbetsmiljö där kompetensutveckling uppmuntras.

Hos Hogia får du en roll där ditt ledarskap och din tekniska förståelse blir avgörande för att forma framtidens produkter.

Tjänsten är placerad i Stenungsund med möjlighet till att arbeta två dagar i veckan på distans.

Vi arbetar med löpande urval och intervjuer, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Om Hogia-gruppen

Hogia utvecklar, säljer och supportar programvaror och IT-system för företag som effektivt vill fokusera på sina verksamheter i stället för krånglig och tidsödande administration. Vi erbjuder allt från mindre löne- och bokföringsprogram för småföretagaren till kompletta, branschspecifika IT-lösningar och -system för exempelvis kollektivtrafik, åkerier, godsterminaler, revisionsbyråer och fastighetsbolag. I Hogiagruppen finns 30 operativa bolag, som vart och ett verkar inom ett väl definierat verksamhetsområde. Vår organisationsform bygger uttalat på småskalighet och entreprenörsanda. Företagskulturen skapar engagerade medarbetare. Tillsammans ger vi våra kunder de bästa tänkbara affärslösningarna. Hogia startade sin verksamhet 1980 i Stenungsund. I dag har den privatägda koncernen totalt 650 anställda på kontor i Sverige, Norge och Finland. Mer information om Hogia finns på www.hogia.se.

Vi på Hogia utvecklar och levererar branschspecifika, verksamhetsstödjande system. Vi har mängder av affärskritiska branschanpassade system som underlättar livet, för att inte tala om lösningar inom ekonomi, lön/HR som passar alla, oavsett bransch.

Vi är experter på att göra administrativa och operativa processer enklare, effektivare och faktiskt lite roligare.

Välkommen till en hel värld av smarta branschlösningar!

jobs.title: Software Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Gillar du att lösa komplexa problem och trivs i en roll där kundkontakt kombineras med djupare tekniskt arbete? Vill du arbeta med teknik som används dagligen i samhället och bidra till att kunder får stabila och smarta lösningar? Då kan rollen som Customer Software Engineer hos vår kund vara rätt för dig.

I rollen får du möjlighet att arbeta med kundnära teknisk support och med ansvar för mjukvaruuppdateringar och releasehantering – en kombination som ger en vardag med både teknisk bredd och mycket kunddialog. Välkommen med din ansökan!

Information om tjänsten

Professionals Nord söker i samarbete med vår kund en Customer Software Engineer. Vår kund är ett teknikföretag med huvudkontor i Linköping. Företaget befinner sig i en stark tillväxtfas och utvecklar tekniska lösningar för kunder såväl i Sverige som på den internationella marknaden. Nu söker de en Customer Software Engineer som vill vara med på deras fortsatta tillväxtresa och bidra till att skapa värde för kunder världen över.

Uppdraget är en del av vår personaluthyrning. Du kommer att vara anställd av Professionals Nord och arbeta som konsult hos vår kund under sex månader. Intentionen är att du på sikt ska bli direktanställd hos dem, förutsatt att alla parter är nöjda med samarbetet.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som Customer Software Engineer arbetar du med teknisk support samtidigt som du ansvarar för hela flödet kring mjukvaru- och firmwareuppdateringar av fältplacerade displayer. Rollen innebär att analysera tekniska problem, driva förbättringar och planera uppdateringar i nära samarbete med utvecklings-, produkt- och supportteam.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter innefattar att:
Felsöka och analysera komplexa mjukvarurelaterade problem samt viss hårdvara
Ansvara för mjukvaru- och firmwareuppdateringar samt hela releaseflödet
Planera och kommunicera uppdateringar och tidsplaner med kund, ta fram release notes och säkerställa korrekt leverans
Samverka med utveckling och andra avdelningar för att driva lösningar framåt
Rapportera och delta i kvalitetsutredningar och följa upp eventuella förbättringsåtgärder
Stödja support- och serviceteamet i relaterade arbetsuppgifter

Vi söker dig som har:

Eftergymnasial utbildning inom data/programmering eller motsvarande relevant arbetslivserfarenhet
Några års erfarenhet från mjukvarunära support, drift, systemhantering eller annan teknisk roll
Erfarenhet av att koordinera, planera eller genomföra releaser, produktionssättningar, deploymenter eller förändringar i mjukvarumiljöer
Goda kunskaper inom backend-programmering, exempelvis C/C++/C# eller Python
Grundläggande kunskaper inom Linux och databaser
Grundläggande förståelse för elektronik, kretsteori eller hårdvara – även på hobbynivå

jobs.title: Software Test Engineer — Verification & Test Automation
jobs.description:
Denna annons är publicerad i samarbete med Jobbet.se. Ansökan sker via Jobbet.se:s hemsida.

Would you like to help build the world’s best artificial heart – a technology that could save the lives of people suffering from severe heart failure? Scandinavian Real Heart (Realheart) is a Swedish company developing and manufacturing an artificial heart that mimics the anatomy and function of the human heart. In Västerås, where the company was originally founded, our team is working to take the technology from development to clinical reality. Realheart is listed on Nasdaq First North Growth and has recently announced its goal of being ready for implantation in its first patient in February 2028.

About the role

We are hiring a Software Test Engineer to own software verification for a Class III medical device system spanning embedded firmware, desktop applications and the communication between them. This is a verification role in the regulatory sense: you will derive test cases from approved software requirements, demonstrate objectively that the software meets them, and produce the traceable, auditable evidence that supports the design history file and technical documentation.

You will also develop and maintain the automation that makes verification repeatable. Using a Python-based test framework integrated with CI/CD, you will help turn regression testing from extensive manual work into reliable pipeline-driven execution.

You will analyse software requirements and design specifications for testability, ambiguity and measurable acceptance criteria. You will create verification plans, protocols and test cases, select and justify suitable verification methods, define expected results and pass/fail criteria, and maintain traceability from requirement through execution record to result.

The role also includes executing protocols under configuration control, documenting objective evidence, managing deviations and amendments, investigating defects, and writing verification reports. You will contribute to design reviews and audits by clearly explaining and defending the verification approach.

On the automation side, you will design, build and maintain test frameworks and automated suites across unit, integration and system levels. This includes developing test harnesses, simulators, stubs and fixtures, as well as supporting hardware-in-the-loop testing where appropriate. You will integrate suites into GitHub Actions and help ensure that automated results can serve as reliable verification evidence.

About you

You have experience of working with software testing in a regulated environment and understand the importance of disciplined design control, configuration management and technical documentation. You are comfortable moving between detailed test work and the broader verification argument, and you can distinguish between requirement, implementation and test defects.

To succeed in the role, you combine a rigorous, structured approach with practical engineering judgement. You communicate clearly in English and enjoy collaborating closely with software, firmware, systems and QA/RA colleagues to keep requirements, code and tests aligned.

What we offer

This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of verification in a complex medical device environment and to contribute to both the verification process and the automation infrastructure that supports it. You will work across embedded firmware, desktop applications and connected interfaces, with a clear opportunity to influence templates, tooling and workflows as verification needs evolve. We welcome you to be a central member of our highly skilled and engaged team.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application. The application period runs from 18 September 2026 to 18 October 2026. For more information please feel welcome to contact Anna Nordanstig +46 70 306 55 64.

Interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the closing date.

Requirements

Experience of software testing in medical devices or another comparably regulated industry, such as aerospace, automotive, rail, nuclear, defence or regulated pharma/IVD.
Understanding of formal design control or safety lifecycles, including the distinction between design verification and design validation.
Demonstrated experience of requirements-driven test design, including defining objective acceptance criteria, maintaining traceability, and producing verification protocols and reports suitable for audit.
Experience of building and maintaining automated test suites, including framework design, test data management and test fixtures.
Experience of version control, change control and formal defect management.
Strong technical documentation skills, with attention to detail and traceability.
Strong spoken and written English.

Preferred qualifications

A Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, computer science or a closely related technical field; equivalent demonstrable experience is also valued.
Working familiarity with .NET/C# and C++, including the ability to read code, understand architecture and create meaningful integration tests.
Practical Python experience for test automation, using a framework such as pytest, unittest or Robot Framework.
CI/CD experience, particularly GitHub Actions, including workflow YAML, runners, matrices, secrets, caching and artifacts.
Experience of IEC 62304 software lifecycle activities, including software safety classification, testing expectations, SOUP management and anomaly evaluation.
Familiarity with ISO 13485, ISO 14971, EU MDR technical documentation and IEC 62366 usability engineering.
Experience of ALM or requirements-management tools such as Polarion, Jama, Codebeamer, DOORS or Azure DevOps, including generating trace matrices.
Experience of embedded or hardware-adjacent testing, for example serial protocols, CAN bus, instrument control, logic analysers, test rigs or hardware-in-the-loop frameworks.
Experience of static analysis, code coverage measurement and their role in software verification.
Experience of FDA inspections, notified body audits, or regulatory submissions such as 510(k), PMA or CE submissions.
Exposure to cybersecurity testing for connected medical devices.

About the employer – Scandinavian Real Heart

Would you like to help build the world’s best artificial heart – a technology that could save the lives of people suffering from severe heart failure?

Scandinavian Real Heart AB is a Swedish MedTech company that develops a total artificial heart (TAH) for implantation in patients with life-threatening heart failure. Realheart® TAH has a unique, patented design that resembles that of the natural human heart. Only about 8,000 heart transplants occur annually worldwide, and the availability of donated hearts is very limited. Realheart’s mission is to save as many patients who suffer from congestive heart disease as possible through this advanced MedTech solution. Realheart has a an extremely competent and engaged team placed in Västerås in Sweden and is also carried out in very close collaboration with world-leading heart surgeons and international researchers and engineers. In 2028 the goal is to be able to perform the first implantation in a human patient. Realheart is a public company listed on Nasdaq First North and has recently announced its goal of being ready for implantation in its first patient in February 2028.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Vill du bygga nästa generations AI-drivna applikationer?

Nu söker vi dig som på riktigt vill arbeta med AI-utveckling, där stora språkmodeller driver smarta och självlärande system. Kanske jobbar du redan idag med Python, LangChain eller OpenAI’s API, eller så har du en bakgrund i Java eller .NET men längtar efter något nyare, snabbare och roligare.

Du har säkert experimenterat på fritiden - byggt egna agenter, testat LangGraph, eller deltagit i ett hackathon bara för att se hur långt du kan ta en idé. Nu vill du ta nästa steg och göra det här på riktigt, i riktiga projekt tillsammans med ett team som brinner för att skapa intelligenta produkter som faktiskt används.

Och det är precis där vi på Compileit kommer in.

Om rollen

Som AI Engineer hos oss blir du en nyckelperson i att bygga AI-lösningar där LLM-teknik står i centrum. Du arbetar tillsammans med våra andra utvecklare, designers och analytiker för att skapa agentiska system som kan resonera, svara och agera självständigt.

Rollen har sitt hjärta i backend, men kräver förståelse för hela kedjan, från server till frontend och användarupplevelse.

Ditt uppdrag innebär bland annat att

Designa och sätta upp arkitektur för agentiska applikationer.
Utveckla backendlösningar som kommunicerar sömlöst med frontend.
Integrera med LLM-plattformar, främst via OpenA’I’s API.
Säkerställa struktur, kvalitet och långsiktig hållbarhet i projekten.
Samarbeta tätt med teamet – från idé till färdig produkt.
Använda verktyg som Claude Code för dokumentation och implementation.

🛠️ Urval av teknik du kommer använda:

Python
LangChain / LangGraph
OpenAI API
Claude Code
Molnplattformar (AWS, Azure, GCP)
JavaScript

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har

Har en naturlig nyfikenhet och vill hela tiden testa nya tekniker och arbetssätt. Om du inte har fått möjlighet att jobba med teknikerna vi nämner här i annonsen så tror vi att du har experimenterat med det på fritiden - byggt egna agenter, testat LangGraph etc.
Har en teknisk utbildning exempelvis från KTH, Uppsala Universitet, Linköpings universitet, Lund Tekniska högskola, Linnéuniversitet eller liknande.
Molnkunskap (AWS, Azure, GCP).
God kommunikationsförmåga och förstår värdet av samarbete mellan teknik, design och affär.
Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska.

Prickar du inte in exakt alla punkter på listan? Testa att söka ändå! Vi är ute efter personer som är nyfikna, drivna och vill lära nytt.

Varför Compileit?

Vi på Compileit skapar smarta och värdeskapande digitala lösningar för appar och webbtjänster. Vi är utvecklare, designers och analytiker som föredrar att skapa mer och krångla mindre. Vi bygger digitala tjänster som verkligen gör skillnad i slutanvändarnas vardag. Att snabbt utveckla enkla lösningar på till synes komplicerade problem styr vår kulturella personlighet. Vi gillar att dela med oss av kunskap och göra skillnad för människor som verkligen betyder något, vi vill göra samhällsnytta på riktigt!

Vårt kontor ligger centralt och här har du närhet till alla tänkbara kommunikationer. Enkelhet är vårt mantra.

Vad får du som anställd hos oss?

☀️ 6 veckors semester

⛷️ Maxat friskvårdsbidrag

👩🏽‍💻 Generösa arbetsverktyg

🫶 Ett team som gillar att utforska, dela kunskap och bygga saker som får andra att säga “hur gjorde ni det där?”

⏱️ Ingen tidsrapportering - vi bryr oss mer om vad du skapar än hur du loggar timmar.

Låter det här som något för dig? Löp och sök! Vi intervjuar löpande.

jobs.title: ERP Integration & Automation Specialist, Lund
jobs.description:
Job Title

ERP Integration & Automation Specialist, Lund

Job Description

Connect the systems that keep a global business moving . Every order Axis fulfills, every product we manufacture, every purchase we make touches our ERP platform. And none of it works unless the systems talk to each other properly.

That's where you come in. We're looking for an ERP Integration and Automation Specialist to join our ERP & PLM Applications team, where you'll build the connections and remove the manual work that slows a fast-growing global business down.

The role is based at our headquarters in Lund or at our office in Linköping.

Who is your future team?

You'll join our ERP & PLM applications team, the group behind some of the most business-critical applications at Axis. We support a global organization and run the full application lifecycle, from daily support to long-term development and upgrades.

The team sits in Lund and Linköping, and we work with colleagues around the world to improve our ERP platform. You'll have people close by to think out loud with, and a global organization to make an impact on.

What will you do here?

Our ERP platform is a global solution that supports many of our core functions, including manufacturing, warehousing, order fulfillment, purchasing, and finance. You'll work closely with users, business stakeholders, and your teammates to solve problems, sharpen end-to-end processes, and shape what comes next.

Your responsibilities include:

Design, build, and maintain integrations between our ERP solution and connected systems
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data flows and integration performance
Make sure integrations stay secure, scalable, and aligned with our architectural guidelines
Spot opportunities to automate manual and repetitive tasks in and around the ERP solution
Help the business put smart automation to work, so processes run smoother
Support implementation and deployment projects
Improve our platform continuously, alongside the rest of the team
Keep solutions consistent by collaborating across functions

Who are we looking for?

You're a team player who enjoys working with people, whether they sit in the next room or on another continent. You're curious about how things fit together, you share your ideas and your knowledge, and you get a small kick out of replacing a manual routine with something that just runs.

You have experience with integration and automation, ideally around Microsoft Dynamics 365 or IFS

We'd love to hear that you have:

A solid understanding of integration patterns, APIs, REST and OData, JSON and XML
Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, such as Power Automate and Power Apps
Experience balancing ongoing support with improvement work and projects
A knack for identifying and refining requirements for business processes and the systems behind them
The initiative to find, track, and resolve issues without waiting to be asked
Familiarity with databases, data modeling, and data management

What Axis Has To Offer

We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact.

Here, you’ll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance — developing solutions used worldwide.

As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You’ll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.

Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration, whether through informal “ fika ” chats, formal meetings,   or after-hours activities. Check it out: Axis HQ

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance — and even your own Axis bicycle.

To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore:

Life at Axis blog 

Engineering at Axis blog 

Innovation at Axis 

Ready to Act?

Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.

If you have any questions, please reach out to recruiting Manager Maria Malmborg, maria.malmborg@axis.com

Type of Employment

Permanent Employment

Posting End Date

2026-09-20

Certain roles at Axis require background checks, which means applicable verifications will be done in these recruitments. Notice will be provided before we take any action.

About Axis Communications

We enable a smarter, safer world by creating innovative solutions for improving security and business performance. As a network technology company and industry leader, we offer solutions in video surveillance, access control, intercom, and audio systems, enhanced by intelligent analytics applications.

With around 6000 committed employees in over 50 countries, we collaborate with partners worldwide. Together, we thrive in our friendly, open, and collaborative culture and inspire each other to think beyond the expected. United by our commitment to inclusion, diversity, and sustainability, we consistently seek to develop our skills and way of working.

Let´s create a smarter, safer world

For more information about Axis, please visit our website www.axis.com.

jobs.description:
Att välja Capgemini innebär att välja en arbetsplats där du ges möjlighet att forma din karriär på det sätt du själv önskar, där du ingår i en stödjande och inspirerande gemenskap med engagerade kollegor världen över, och där du får chansen att omdefiniera vad som är möjligt. Våra Cloud & Custom Applications team fokuserar på att utveckla skräddarsydda, skalbara och säkra cloudapplikationer, integrera IT-system och driva affärstransformation. AI är en nyckelteknologi i allt vi gör och en central del i hur vi formar och bygger moderna system och lösningar, där intelligenta AI-drivna arbetssätt och teknologier som Agentic AI driver utvecklingen framåt. Bli en del av oss och var med och forma framtidens system tillsammans med världsledande organisationer och bidra till att frigöra teknikens fulla potential i en mer hållbar och inkluderande värld!

Om rollen

Som integrationsutvecklare hos Capgemini blir du en nyckelspelare i utvecklingen av moderna integrationslösningar. Du arbetar nära kunden för att skapa hållbara och skalbara integrationer, samtidigt som du bidrar i plattformsresor, transformationer och tekniska förnyelseprojekt. Du anställs för din kompetens och inte bara för ett specifikt uppdrag. Detta ger dig möjlighet till variation, att både rotera mellan uppdrag och utbildning. Vilket är grunden för din utveckling. I denna position kommer du att spela en nyckelroll i:

Designa, implementera och underhålla integrationer samt genomföra analyser och utveckla strategier för att framtidssäkra integrationsmetoder, inklusive etablering av Centers for Enablement.
Genomföra molnmigreringar till Azure med hjälp av Azure integrationstjänster, hantera generell plattformsosäkerhet och underlätta övergångar mellan tekniska plattformar.
Stödja andra transformationer såsom ERP för att påskynda leverans och bidra till Capgeminis interna nätverk samt andra initiativ som utvecklar vår verksamhet.
Utveckla strategier för att framtidssäkra integrationsmetoder och etablera Centers for Enablement som en del av den långsiktiga tekniska plattformsutvecklingen.

Din profil

Du är en erfaren integrationsutvecklare som trivs i konsultrollen och gillar att driva utveckling, utmana när det behövs och skapa lösningar som gör verklig skillnad. Du är proaktiv, prestigelös och samarbetsorienterad. Du ser helheten, kommunicerar tydligt och tar ansvar i både team och kunddialoger. Vi ser att du behärskar både svenska och engelska obehindrat i tal och skrift. Du är expert inom några av följande områden, gärna flera:

AI driven utveckling: Erfarenhet av att använda AI och agentic arbetssätt för att planera, skriva och förbättra kod.
Integrationsmönster: Stark förståelse för EIP såsom händelsedrivet, API baserat, batch, streaming och datatransformation.
Teknisk integrationsbredd: Van vid Azure Integration Services, kodbaserad integration (C#/Java, REST/GraphQL) och iPaaS (tex: BizTalk, MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Frends)
Modern leverans & drift: Meriterande erfarenhet av DevOps, CI/CD, Kubernetes, IaC och observability.
Du behärskar svenska och engelska i både i tal och skrift

Vad vi tror kommer att få dig att trivas

Inspirerande arbetsmiljö med fokus på innovation, kundnöjdhet och samarbete, du arbetar med de senaste trenderna inom Cloud & Application Integration tillsammans med skickliga kollegor i ett erfaret team som levererar till både offentlig och privat sektor.
AI driven utveckling med agentiska metoder, designa skalbara lösningar i teknikens framkant.
Starkt lokalt och globalt nätverk: expertis, stöd och kunskapsutbyte i Norden såväl som internationellt.
Kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling och karriärmöjligheter, med tillgång till över 250 000 kurser och certifieringar samt regelbundna dialoger med din teamchef kring uppdrag, mål och utveckling.
Värderingsdriven kultur: Honesty, Boldness, Trust, Freedom, Team Spirit, Modesty och Fun.

Ansökan

Vi arbetar normalt med löpande urval, men på grund av semester under juli kan det dröja till början av augusti innan vi går igenom din ansökan. Vi återkommer så snart som möjligt därefter. Vi ser framemot din ansökan och att du vill bli en del av vår fortsatta resa!
Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov.

Description

Laserfiche is looking for a Principal Software Engineer to drive the modernization of legacy Microsoft-based systems while architecting and operating scalable, resilient AWS-native cloud infrastructure. This role leads the design and implementation of next-generation platforms, leveraging deep expertise in cloud engineering, distributed systems, and modern software development practices.

As a key innovator within the engineering organization, the Principal Software Engineer embeds artificial intelligence—particularly large language models (LLMs)—into both development workflows and product capabilities, accelerating delivery, enhancing developer productivity, and enabling intelligent, data-driven features.

This position requires a hands-on leader who has successfully migrated complex systems to the cloud, possesses strong expertise in AWS services and architecture, and actively applies AI/ML technologies to solve real-world engineering challenges. The ideal candidate thrives in forward-leaning environments, shaping technical strategy while mentoring teams and setting engineering excellence standards across the organization.

Responsibilities

Platform Modernization

Lead migration of .NET / Windows-based systems to Linux and AWS
Re-architect legacy applications into cloud-native services
Move from tightly coupled systems to modular, scalable architecture

AWS-Based System Design and Delivery

Design and operate production systems using: EKS / Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS/Aurora
Build infrastructure using: Terraform or CloudFormation
Own CI/CD pipelines and deployment strategies using: TFS and AzureDevOps

AI-Driven Development

Use AI to write, design, and accelerate software development
Using LLMs (OpenAI, Copilot, Anthropic, etc.) for:
Code generation and refactoring
Test generation
API design and documentation
Building internal tooling that uses AI to improve developer velocity
Leveraging AI to speed up debugging, migrations, and system design

AI-Powered Product Features

Build and integrate AI-driven capabilities into the product, such as:
Document ingestion and semantic search (RAG)
Workflow automation powered by LLMs
Agentic systems that take actions across services

Design systems that combine:
Structured data, unstructured content, AI reasoning, deterministic workflows

Content & Workflow Systems

Work with document/content management systems
Build workflow-driven pipelines (approval, routing, automation)
Enhance workflows using:
AI classification
Summarization
Decision support

Bachelor’s Degree
10+ years’ experience in software engineering
Experience migrating from Windows to Linux Environments
Experience decomposing monolithic applications into cloud architecture

Strong background in:
C# / .NET (including modernization to .NET Core/.NET 6+)
Backend systems and API design

Deep experience with AWS services (not just exposure)
Experience building and running production systems
Strong understanding of observability, scaling, resilience
Actively use AI tools in your development workflow
Have built at least one real AI-powered feature or system
Understand concepts like:
RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
Embeddings and vector search
Prompt design and system orchestration

Have experimented with or built:
Agentic workflows or multi-step AI pipelines

Able to make pragmatic tradeoffs in:
Migration strategies
Build vs buy decisions

Comfortable working across:
Legacy systems
Modern cloud platforms
Emerging AI tooling

solutions, ensuring they are scalable, secure, maintainable and aligned with wider business objectives.

The Opportunity

As Software Architect, you’ll take ownership of solution-level architecture across new software development initiatives. You’ll work closely with product, project and technical stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, while providing architectural leadership to development teams.

The role offers the opportunity to work with modern Microsoft technologies, including Azure PaaS

What you'll be doing

Define and design software architectures that meet business, functional and non-functional requirements.
Make architectural decisions covering scalability, performance, security, resilience, maintainability and accessibility
.
Translate business and technical requirements into practical, scalable software solutions.
Lead architectural discussions with product managers, project managers, developers, technical leads and other stakeholders.
Establish and promote software architecture standards, patterns and best practices.
Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
Review designs and code to ensure solutions adhere to agreed architectural and engineering standards.
Identify technical risks, dependencies and challenges, developing appropriate mitigation strategies.
Evaluate and recommend technologies, frameworks and tools in line with the wider technology strategy.
Contribute to the software development roadmap and support proof-of-concept initiatives where appropriate.
Support development teams with complex technical issues and troubleshooting when required.
Mentor and coach developers and other technical team members, helping to raise engineering capability.
Ensure software development and implementation align with organisational standards and governance.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a strong .NET/Azure technical architect
with a proven track record of designing and delivering complex software solutions in an enterprise environment.

Essential experience

Extensive commercial experience with C#, .NET Framework and modern .NET
.
Strong practical experience designing and developing solutions on Microsoft Azure
.
Strong understanding of Azure PaaS
services and cloud development patterns.
Proven experience designing complex, scalable and maintainable software systems.
Strong knowledge of software architecture patterns, development principles and engineering best practices.

Strong understanding of REST APIs and API-led integration
.
Experience with Azure DevOps
and modern software delivery practices.
Familiarity with SonarQube
and code-quality practices.

including performance, security, scalability and resilience.
Awareness of accessibility standards
and their application within software solutions.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and influence stakeholders at different levels.
Experience providing technical leadership, mentoring and guidance to software development teams.

Experience with front-end technologies such as JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS and jQuery
.
Experience working within large-scale enterprise or transformation programmes.
Experience establishing or evolving software architecture standards and governance.
Experience with proof-of-concept development and technology evaluation.

Why consider this opportunity?

This is an opportunity to join a significant technology transformation environment where you'll have genuine scope to influence architecture, shape technical direction and work on complex enterprise solutions
.

You'll work alongside experienced engineering and technology professionals, with exposure to modern Microsoft technologies and the opportunity to contribute beyond individual projects.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description:
MongoDB is looking for an outstanding person to join our newly created Forward Deployed Engineering team and take on a key role in our extended R&D organization. Forward Deployed Engineering is linking the work of teams engaged on application modernization roles with our Product and Engineering teams.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin or Cork for our hybrid working model.

Many organizations have built up large estates of legacy applications. Lack of scalability and resilience, long development times, operating cost, and inability to run on cloud are common issues with these applications. To address these issues, organizations are engaging in large transformational Application Modernisation programs. MongoDB is recognized as the developer data platform of choice for transactional systems that provide the best scalability, resiliency and developer experience in the cloud as well as on premises. Organizations are continuously migrating workloads from these legacy applications to new platforms, often based on microservices, using MongoDB.

Such transformations are time intensive and often risky. Tooling based on generative AI promises to accelerate these transformations in a way never seen before. Forward Deployed Engineering is responsible for exploring the possibilities of Generative AI technologies and providing invaluable feedback to MongoDB’s R&D teams to drive future capabilities of MongoDB and the MongoDB ecosystem.

Application Modernization Engineers will work alongside project teams that are executing Application Modernisation projects with customers. The successful candidate will be responsible for evaluation, build, and applying tools in modernization projects, facilitating the usage of such tools and processes across the different project teams, identifying opportunities for tooling deployment, selecting potential 3rd party tools, contributing to the development of tooling prototypes and helping to shape the product roadmap.

Our ideal candidate will have

4+ years of experience as a field engineer or professional services consultant or full stack developer working directly with Enterprise clients
Proficiency in Java or C#, and some familiarity with common database access patterns and frameworks in one or more of these languages
Strong knowledge about enterprise-scale software architectures, application development methodologies, and software deployment and operations
Experience developing enterprise applications using relational databases, and employing SQL and stored procedures with Oracle, MS SQL Server, Sybase and/or PostgreSQL databases
Experience of using and developing with MongoDB and JSON based Document models is highly desirable
Problem solving skills, including the ability to collaborate across disciplines and teams to come up with creative solutions to technical and business challenges
Willingness to dive into a complex domain, ask the right questions, and bring new software tools and technologies to the table to solve customer problems
Great communication skills (both spoken and written), within the team and in customer meetings
Good understanding of Generative AI concepts, tools, and services. Any experience to build new applications/tools using Generative AI is a big plus. That includes Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini, and OpenAI APIs
And finally, a strong interest in how AI supported toolchains can improve application development

Position Expectations

Contribute to customer application modernization initiatives at any or all phases of the application lifecycle: assessment and analysis; planning and design; data modeling; application code conversion, development, test and build; integration and release configuration, production operations, application optimisation, and best practices adoption
Test drive MongoDB migration products to deliver on customer use cases and drive adoption of the product. Deliver concise feedback to the rest of the development organisation
Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to influence the direction of the MongoDB product roadmap
Personally execute POCs including developing or extending existing tools when necessary and appropriate for customer success, with an eye towards reusability and eventual integration with our products. These are often on premises at client locations
Maintain a broad and deep technical understanding of the product line and the underlying technologies and protocols
Work as part of a wider delivery team comprising consulting engineers from MongoDB Professional Services, project managers, and account teams
Assist sales teams in evaluating opportunities with prospects and customers
Willingness to work on site with customers for 7 days per month, which includes regional travel (within Europe)

Success Measures

The Senior Forward Deployed Engineer will be successful in this role when they can execute the following strategic tasks/responsibilities:

Become an expert level user of MongoDB, and our tools current migration products
Develop a playbook for customer application modernization engagements, in collaboration with other MongoDB Engineers, Product Management and Engineering
Communicate complex technical proposals simply and convincingly to a wide range of audiences
Provide unique insight into customer needs, product requirements and strategic opportunities by contributing experience from the field
Gain the reputation as a trusted advisor with our field teams and customers
Contribute to the success of customer application migration initiatives that they support

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: Stavanger or Oslo (Norway)

Reports to: Engineering Manager - APIs Lead

Language Requirements: English

The Opportunity

At Easee, we're building technology that makes electrification effortless. Our products are used across Europe, and our success depends on attracting people who share our ambition, curiosity, and commitment to great results.

As our Software Engineer, you'll help build, test, and maintain the RESTful APIs and microservices that power Easee's platform. You'll write clean, well-tested code while working closely with senior engineers on backend architecture. This is a role designed for someone with solid backend foundations who is ready to take ownership of real services in a supportive, collaborative environment.

Working alongside the API team, Frontend Engineers, the Platform team, and Product Support, you will help make sure our services are reliable, well-tested, and built to scale.

What's In It For You

A collaborative environment with experienced senior engineers for code reviews, architectural discussions, and technical sparring
High ownership over feature design and implementation, backed by strong team support when you need it
Opportunities to design end-to-end systems independently, particularly in the EV charger domain
A clear path from Software Engineer to Senior Software Engineer as you grow

Core Outcomes

Short-term

You have completed onboarding, set up your local development environment, and have a clear understanding of our core API codebases.
You have shipped early bug fixes and feature enhancements to production, building familiarity with our system architecture and review practices.
You have integrated smoothly into the API team's daily workflows, code review practices, and sprint cadence.

Long-term

You have full autonomy in designing and deploying end-to-end API features.
You have a deep understanding of our core system architecture and data flows.
You actively contribute ideas that improve our test and development workflows.

What You Need To Bring Along

A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or equivalent practical experience. Relevant hands-on experience can compensate for formal education.
2–4 years of professional backend development experience in a production environment.
Proven experience building, testing, and maintaining RESTful APIs or microservices.
Core programming skills in at least one backend language (e.g., .Net and C# (what we use), Java, or Go).
A solid understanding of REST principles, HTTP, and relational or NoSQL databases.
Familiarity with Git, Docker, automated testing frameworks, and CI/CD pipelines.

Interview Process

(30m) Recruiter Screen
(30m) Hiring Manager Screen
(90m) Hands-On Challenge and Technical Deep Dive

We request two professional references in our final round. We may conduct background checks if necessary.

Who we are

Easee is a Norwegian technology company with a clear purpose: Effortless Electrification for All.

We develop smart charging and energy solutions designed to make access to electrification simpler, smarter, and more scalable.

Our Culture Is Built Around Three Values

Dare:
We challenge assumptions and explore new possibilities.

Care:
We support each other, our partners, and our customers.

Deliver:
We take ownership and follow through on our commitments.

We believe great results come from ambitious people who care about each other, challenge the status quo, and take ownership.

What We Offer

A key role in developing Easee's next-generation EV chargers
The chance to work alongside some of the experts behind one of the world's best-selling EV chargers
Collaboration with skilled colleagues across hardware, software, and product
A part in Easee's international expansion into new markets
A modern company culture that values innovation, people, and fun
Competitive salary and benefits package

jobs.description:
Systemutvikling er vår spisskompetanse, og våre teknologer har lang erfaring med å gjøre om komplekse behov til brukervennlige løsninger. Vi hjelper kunder med å gjøre komplekse behov til brukervennlige digitale løsninger – fra automatisering av 800 000 årlige søknader om Europeisk helsetrygdkort til prosjekter innen autonome skip og bærekraftig havbruk. På Ålesundskontoret får du kombinere store, nasjonale prosjekter med et tett samarbeid med næringslivet på Sunnmøre, og bidra til løsninger som skaper verdi i en av Norges mest fremtidsrettede regioner.

I Twoday kan du starte karrieren som fast ansatt sammen med en håndplukket gjeng. Målet er å få deg raskt ut på prosjekt – parallelt med spennende kurs, fagkvelder og reiser. Gjennom vårt skreddersydde opplæringsprogram og veiledning av våre erfarne konsulenter, leverer våre graduates raskt på toppnivå og skaper konkrete resultater for kunder.

Som utvikler i Twoday kan du forvente spennende, komplekse og samfunnsnyttige prosjekter. På prosjekt jobber vi ofte i større team, og du får jobbe med både utviklere, arkitekter, designere og prosjektleder. Vi hjelper kundene våre ved bruk av teknologier som .NET, Java, C#, JavaScript, kunstig intelligens og skyplattformer som Azure og AWS. Vi ligger langt framme i å benytte KI-verktøy, på en bærekraftig og ansvarlig måte.

Vil du vite mer om hvordan det er å starte som Nytt Krutt? Bli kjent med oss på vår nettside.

Vi ser etter deg som

Har fullført en relevant bachelor- /mastergrad før oppstart i august 2027
Trives godt i rollen som fullstack- eller backendutvikler
Ønsker å jobbe som konsulent og i team
Drives av å tilegne deg ny kunnskap og lære bort til andre
Har gode kommunikasjonsevner, og behersker norsk som arbeidsspråk

Vi har løpende opptak, og ansetter kandidater fortløpende frem til alle plassene er fylt. Første intervjuer holdes i uke 34-35.

Alt du trenger å gjøre er å laste opp CV og karakterutskrift. Istedenfor søknadsbrev har vi også noen spørsmål slik at vi kan bli bedre kjent med deg. Hold svarene korte og konsise, 2-5 setninger holder lenge.

jobs.title: Erfaren backend utvikler
jobs.description:
Hver gang noen lader, vasker eller fyller drivstoff hos Uno-X, skal det bare fungere. Det krever systemer som håndterer millioner av transaksjoner, tusenvis av ladestasjoner og kunder i hele Norden – hver eneste dag.

Alt skal fungere sømløst, selv når trafikken øker og integrasjonene ikke gjør det enkelt.
Nå styrker vi utviklingsmiljøet vårt med en erfaren backendutvikler som vil være med å bygge videre på plattformen og tjenestene som driver fremtidens mobilitet .

Om rollen

Som erfaren backendutvikler blir du en sentral del av et tverrfaglig produktteam som bygger og videreutvikler Elton-plattformen. Du jobber tett med andre utviklere, produktledelse og fagmiljøer for å finne de beste løsningene. Både teknisk og for brukeren.
Du blir med når vi diskuterer hva som bør bygges, hvorfor vi skal bygge det og hvordan det bør løses. Du får derfor stor påvirkning på både tekniske valg, produktretning og hvordan plattformen utvikler seg videre.
Vi jobber med komplekse problemer der kravene ikke alltid er perfekte og der fasiten ikke nødvendigvis finnes. Du må derfor trives med å ta beslutninger, utfordre etablerte sannheter og finne pragmatiske løsninger som også fungerer på lang sikt.

Dette får du ansvar for

Utvikle og videreutvikle backendtjenester som håndterer lading, betaling og digitale kundereiser
Bygge integrasjoner mot tusenvis av ladestasjoner og eksterne aktører gjennom blant annet OCPI
Utvikle robuste og skalerbare API-er og tjenester som håndterer høyt transaksjonsvolum
Bidra til arkitekturvalg og videreutvikling av plattformen
Jobbe med distribuerte systemer, sanntidsdata og integrasjoner mot eksterne systemer
Ta eierskap til løsninger fra idé og utvikling til produksjon og videre drift
Samarbeide tett med produkt, frontend, andre teknologimiljøer og eksterne partnere
Være med å forme hvordan vi bygger og skalerer teknologien videre i Norden

Vi ser etter deg som har

Solid erfaring som backendutvikler, gjerne fem år eller mer
Sterk kompetanse i Kotlin eller Java, og gjerne erfaring med TypeScript på backend
Erfaring fra tverrfaglige produktteam og moderne utviklingsmiljøer
God forståelse av SQL, API-design og distribuerte systemer
Erfaring med skyplattformer, gjerne Google Cloud, men AWS eller Azure er også relevant
Erfaring med CI/CD og eierskap til kode i produksjon
Evne til å balansere pragmatiske løsninger med langsiktig teknisk kvalitet
Interesse for produktet og brukeren, ikke bare teknologien
Lyst til å ta ansvar, dele kunnskap og bidra til hvordan teamet jobber

Det er en fordel om du også har erfaring med Kafka eller PubSub, eventdrevne systemer eller skalering av relasjonsdatabaser. Du trenger ikke å kunne alt fra dag én. Det viktigste er at du har solid backendkompetanse og lyst til å forstå domenet du bygger for.

Hvorfor Uno- X

 Du får stor påvirkningskraft på både teknologi, arkitektur og produkt
 Du jobber med en moderne stack i full produksjon
Du får være med på å skalere en plattform som skal brukes på tvers av Norden
Du får tryggheten fra et stort konsern gjennom Reitan Retail, kombinert med tempoet og påvirkningskraften til et produktmiljø i vekst
Kort vei fra idé til produksjon og kort vei til faglig sparring
Flere produkter på samme infrastruktur gir muligheter for å ta mer ansvar og utforske nye domener over tid

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect – GridOS & Energy systems
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

As a Senior Solutions Architect – GridOS & Energy Systems, you will play a pivotal role in supporting the long-term success of strategic customer deployments by defining and governing the architecture for the maintenance, evolution, and integration of GE Vernova solutions within the customer environment, in complex OT and IT environments.

Based in Oslo and working in close proximity to the customer, including regular presence on customer site, you will act as the bridge between customer stakeholders, Services, Product Management, and Engineering teams. You will ensure best-in-class and optimal technical design aligned with customer functional and non-functional requirements, while promoting the use of standard products, standard interfaces, and reference architectures.

This role is focused on post-sales delivery adoption, strategic technical leadership, and integration architecture across OT and IT environments, with particular relevance to energy systems, OT platforms, and Energy Management Systems.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Solution Architecture & Solution Evolution

Define and maintain architecture for integrations between GE Vernova solutions and customer-owned applications across OT and IT environments.
Ensure design proposals address functional and non-functional requirements, including performance, availability, cybersecurity, maintainability, and scalability.
Promote standardization through the use of reference architectures, reference solutions, and reusable design patterns.
Evaluate the impact of changes and enhancements on the existing deployed solution landscape and surrounding systems.

Collaboration And Delivery

Work in coordination with the Services function, including Technical Leads Managers and Project Managers, to support successful implementation and adoption.
Manage the involvement of SMEs, including cybersecurity, infrastructure, domain, and integration experts, and ensure their contributions meet system architecture requirements.
Collaborate with Product Managers and Engineering teams on return on experience, product enhancements, and continuous improvement.
Coordinate knowledge capitalization and dissemination across Services and Solution Design teams.
Be accountable for planning architecture activities, reporting progress, and completing activities in scope in line with approved budgets and timelines.

Skills & Qualifications

Must Have:

Previous experience as Solution Architect. Technical Architect or similar role in a comparable domain
Strong experience with critical systems having demanding requirements in terms of 24/7 availability.
Experience in energy systems, OT environments, or Energy Management Systems.
Strong understanding of integration architectures spanning OT and IT environments.
Cloud architecture experience (AWS and/or Azure) and experience with cloud-native technologies such as containers and Kubernetes.
Strong understanding of microservices design principles, including RESTful services and API development.
Experience working with Kubernetes in production environments.
Experience with systems deployed in on-premise / virtualized environments (Windows, Linux, VMware).
Exposure to iterative product development and program management techniques including Agile, SAFe, Scrum, and DevOps.
Strong awareness of cybersecurity principles and data protection considerations, particularly as they relate to critical infrastructure.
Ability to define architectures using standard products, standard interfaces, and appropriate architecture patterns to meet business and technical requirements.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Professional English level.

Nice To Have

Energy sector / Electric utility Industry domain knowledge,
Experience with OT/SCADA systems for monitoring and controlling industrial processes
Knowledge of emerging energy industry trends and implications on utility customers (Renewables and DER orchestration, distribution planning, IT, SCADA)
Experience in a forward deployed, resident, or embedded customer-facing architecture role.
Understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF.
Experience in Services or software commissioning in OT environments.
Norwegian language skills.

Soft Skills

Strong customer engagement and stakeholder management skills.
Business-oriented mindset with strong technical literacy.
Strong problem-solving abilities and capability to articulate specific technical topics and architectural decisions.
Ability to influence across customer and internal teams.
Ownership mindset with focus on long-term customer success and solution sustainability.

Candidates are informed that GE Vernova Norway will process only electronically submitted applications and require all relevant attachments to be included. GE Vernova Norway operates in sectors of critical infrastructure and strictly adheres to statutory security requirements and guidelines issued by Datatilsynet, the Norwegian Data Protection Authority, in our hiring processes. We conduct thorough background checks and suitability assessments in accordance with applicable regulations, including personal data protection legislations as the new Norwegian Personal Data Act (LOV-2018-06-15-38) (" PDA
") . For roles requiring security clearance and access to sensitive government documents according to the Energy Act, candidates must be prepared to provide the necessary information as part of the Security Clearance process, as required under and in compliance with PDA and the Energy Act. All personal data will be handled with the utmost confidentiality and in accordance with our data protection policies, solely for recruitment and security purposes.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided:
No

jobs.title: Software Developer (Application development)
jobs.description:
NAPA Design Solutions offers a comprehensive solution for 3D ship modeling and design tools covering hull form design and hydrodynamics, hydrostatics and stability, structural design, and information sharing across the shipbuilding process. These are among the most powerful tools in the industry, trusted by the world's largest shipyards and classification societies.

The role: what is it about?

The team is now looking for a Software Developer who will focus on application usability development with .NET, C#, WPF and XAML. Development, testing, and maintenance of the NAPA ship design solutions are part of your daily work. In this role you will mainly work on developing NAPA Engineer, a modern design and computing platform for naval architects. It combines trusted NAPA calculation capabilities with a redesigned, intuitive user experience and a powerful visual approach to engineering workflows. You can read more about the solution at: https://www.napa.fi/software-and-services/ship-design/software/napa-engineer/

You will do this work with artificial intelligence (AI) as a normal part of your toolchain. We use agentic coding capability across our development teams, which means using AI coding agents to plan, write, test, review and refactor code, and doing it in a way that improves both delivery speed and code quality. We expect you to use these tools in your daily work, to help us learn where they work well and where they do not, and to share those learnings with your team.

You will be working with Windows desktop applications, native libraries, third-party components, including a 3D graphics library, database engines, a licensing solution, and more
.

This job is permanent and full-time
.

Your team and job location

You will work in an international team where your closest colleagues are experienced software developers and naval architectural domain experts who will support you in your role. You will also interact with local and global colleagues
from various teams in software development, UX design, DevOps, and sales. Together with them you will also shape how we use AI coding agents in practice, from tooling choices to review practices.

Our office is located in Helsinki (Ruoholahti), and you can work at the office or in hybrid mode
. We hope to meet you at our Helsinki office regularly.

What are we looking for?

What matters most: you're curious about UI development, energized by AI-assisted development tools, and hungry to solve real problems as a self-starter
. If the visual side of UI excites you too, that's a big plus.

Our Ideal Candidate Would Have

Academic degree in a relevant field such as computer science, mathematics, physics, naval architecture, or engineering
Completed basic studies and/or having a good understanding of algorithms, data structures, and OOP (object-oriented programming)
2+ years of experience in building native Windows desktop applications
Experience in UI design
Experience using WPF, C#, and XAML
Understanding of user experience and the ability to apply it in your own design work
Hands-on experience of using AI coding assistants or coding agents in real development work, together with the judgment to review, test and take responsibility for what they produce
Interest in NAPA’s domain (maritime business)

Additionally, The Following Skills Would Be Considered An Advantage

Experience with agentic coding workflows
Knowledge or studies in usability
Experience with database solutions
Experience in automated testing methods
Knowledge of software reliability and maintainability
Experience in CAD or CAE applications

You do not need to tick every box on these lists. If this role feels like a good fit for you and you have most of what we are looking for, we hope you will apply.

We work in English
across all our offices, so you need to be comfortable using it in your daily work, both in writing and in conversation.

Why you will enjoy working in this role

You get to combine modern desktop application development on a next-generation engineering platform, combined with AI agentic development that we are scaling across the company
The design work of the world's largest shipyards and classification societies happens in the software you develop
Great colleagues with expertise in, for example, naval architecture, software development and UX design
A global team of 230 experts who support you and share what they know
When you join NAPA, you will be assigned an onboarding buddy who will help ensure a smooth start and introduce you to the NAPA way of working

Ready to get on board and join the napa crew?

We kindly ask you to send your application and CV to us as soon as possible (by clicking the "Apply for this job" button on the job ad page), but no later than 11 October 2026
. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate has been found.

For more information about the position, please send your questions by e-mail to jobs@napa.fi. Notice that we cannot accept job applications sent by e-mail.

NAPA as a company and as an employer

With over 35 years of operation, NAPA is a leading software and data services provider for ship design and operations to enable safe, sustainable, and future-proof maritime industry. Headquartered in Finland, NAPA employs 230 experts, combining expertise in naval architecture, fleet operations and digital services. NAPA operates globally, with a presence in Japan, Korea, China, Singapore, the USA, Germany, Greece, Romania and India.

With over 90% of new vessels built by NAPA customers, NAPA’s ship design software is the global de facto standard in shipbuilding. Furthermore, NAPA is a market leader in ship stability management and safety data services for passenger ships, and its cloud-based solutions for ship performance monitoring and voyage optimization support shipping’s decarbonization journey. For more information, visit www.napa.fi .

Meaningful work

We are proud to play our part in creating a sustainable world, and a career at NAPA means working with a purpose. We focus on building the best possible products for our customers, with whom we have close and long-lasting relationships. We protect the environment and human life at sea by powering safer and greener vessels with our technology.

NAPA way of working

At NAPA, we lead and manage the company together. We help and learn from each other, while making impactful decisions for a cleaner, safer maritime industry.

At its heart, our co-leadership philosophy is founded on trust. We trust that our people are smart enough that if they make a decision, having consulted the right people, it will be good for our company. And if it's not the right decision on that occasion, that's fine too. We trust that we'll make it right, learn from the decision, and grow as a company as a result.

Enjoy working together

is one of our core values. Learning from and respecting each other provides a healthy and pleasant working environment. We, as NAPArians, share our knowledge and help each other when needed. NAPA has offices and customers around the world, and you will be able to meet people from many different cultures. We are a diverse team with a shared goal.

Read more about our values and culture: https://www.napa.fi/careers/

Read more about NAPA: https://www.napa.fi/

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Internal Platform and APIs - Greenstep Espoo
jobs.description:
Have you ever looked at a sprawling internal IT estate and known exactly how much smaller and safer it could be?
We have one. Hundreds of repositories and thousands of Azure Functions, Logic Apps and low-code flows, built by many hands over many years. We are looking for one person to own turning it into a small number of well-designed, centralized APIs running on Kubernetes.

Greenstep is a Finnish, family-owned growth company
founded in 2010 that provides high-quality technology and back-office services to support its clients' growth and success. Today we are a community of more than 800 experts
working in the Nordics and across Europe. We have grown organically, and today Greenstep has people in Finland, Åland, Sweden, Norway, Estonia, Denmark and the Netherlands. We share one goal: to help growth companies become leaders in their fields.

Our internal automation grew as fast as the company did. It works, mostly, and nobody can see all of it. That is the problem you will solve.

The Role

You own the target architecture for Greenstep's internal platform
and you build a large part of it yourself. You lead our internal developers technically,
and you decide what gets consolidated, what gets rewritten and what gets deleted. Deleting is a big part of the job.

What will you do as a Staff Engineer:

Set and own the target architecture and build most of it. A handful of centralized, versioned APIs with clear ownership, running on AKS, with authentication, observability and access control solved once instead of in every repo.
Inventory the estate, then shrink it. You map what exists, decide what gets consolidated, what gets rewritten and what gets deleted. Deleting is a big part of the job.
Design the migration so it is boring. Functions and Kubernetes run side by side while traffic shifts incrementally. No big-bang cutover, no weekend where payroll stops.
Move business logic out of low-code. HR, payroll, finance and client onboarding flows become services that can be tested, versioned and reused.
Build the platform, not just the services. Service templates, CI/CD, GitOps, infrastructure as code, secrets handling, API gateway, tracing and metrics. You set the standard by shipping it first.
Make agentic development normal here. Migrating thousands of functions by hand is not realistic. You design the workflow, the review gates and the guardrails that keep AI-generated code safe to put in front of payroll data, and you use these tools heavily yourself.
Lead the internal developers technically. Architecture reviews, pairing, code review, and a roadmap business stakeholders can actually follow.
Partner with the App Factory staff engineer, who owns the internal applications, so those apps consume your APIs instead of talking to source systems directly.

What We're Looking For

You have taken a sprawling estate and made it smaller and safer before. You can describe what you kept, what you killed, and how you got people to agree.
You are as comfortable
in a design review as you are explaining to a payroll team why their flow is being replaced and what they gain.

What you bring:

7+ years in software and cloud engineering, including several years leading platform or API consolidation at scale. You can describe an estate you made smaller: what you kept, what you killed, and how you got people to agree.
Deep Python backend experience, and the judgment to know when a service should not be Python at all.
Production Kubernetes you have operated, not just deployed: Helm, GitOps, ingress, secrets, resource limits, upgrades.
Event-driven workloads on Kubernetes, specifically KEDA or equivalent. You know why scale-to-zero and queue-depth scaling decide whether this migration saves money or costs it.
Azure fluency: networking, security, Entra ID, Workload Identity, Key Vault, API Management, Functions and Logic Apps, including how to migrate off the parts that should not be there.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Web Platform
jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are hiring for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Web Platform team here at Unity. Unity's Web platform lets games and real-time 3D content run in a browser, on any internet connected device. Browser capability has moved fast, browser gaming is going through a revival, and the Unity Web runtime is what makes it possible. Our work also supports an exciting new partnership with a major platform, which puts what this team builds in front of audiences at a scale few browser platforms reach.

In this role, you will own meaningful areas of the runtime outright. This is not website development. We embed Unity inside the browser, and the problems are the deep ones: making a single-threaded platform multi-threaded, cutting megabytes out of a build, getting a game playable in seconds rather than minutes. You will work alongside engineers who helped invent the browser technology we build on, and you will help the people around you grow.

What You'll Be Doing

Own meaningful areas of the Unity Web runtime, from design through to release
Research, design and implement optimizations to the Web build target, such as stripping unused code from builds and progressively loading assets as a game needs them
Improve download size, load and startup performance for Web builds, and set measurable targets for it
Solve uncommon, low-level problems across C++, C# and JavaScript, for example bringing multi-threading to parts of the runtime that are single-threaded today
Partner with teams across Unity who build on the Web platform, translating what they need into platform work
Mentor teammates and help set the bar for code quality across the team
Keep Unity at the frontier of the Web's constantly evolving capabilities

What We're Looking For

Deep, hands-on proficiency with C++ in performance sensitive code
Development experience with WebAssembly, using Emscripten and/or LLVM
Ability to decompose complex technical problems and complete them on your own technical judgment
Experience profiling, debugging and optimizing across the native and browser boundary
Working knowledge of C# and JavaScript
Effective written/verbal communication with peers, managers and key decision makers in other teams
A proven track record of mentoring engineers and raising code quality standards

You might also have

Experience contributing to a browser engine or browser runtime
Deeper domain knowledge of rendering, physics or audio in a real-time 3D engine
Familiarity with compression methodologies and build size reduction

jobs.location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Build software at scale. Influence how we build it. Help modernize a product area at the heart of construction projects.

Dalux is growing, and we are looking for an experienced software developer to join our team called "Tender".

You will work on software that supports the bidding process for construction projects and is tightly integrated with the wider Dalux platform. It is a domain where reliability, data security, and good technical design matter – and where there is plenty of opportunity to influence how the product and architecture evolve.

You will also have the opportunity to influence how we increasingly use AI to make software development more effective.

Your role

As an Experienced Software Developer, you will take ownership of complex product and technical problems from idea to production.

You will join a full-stack development team working closely with a Product Manager and Product Designer. We expect experienced developers to contribute beyond their individual tasks: helping make good technical decisions, improving the codebase and architecture, sharing knowledge, and raising the engineering standard around them.

Within Tender, there is a particular focus on strengthening and evolving the technical foundation of the product while continuing to deliver new functionality.

Your work can include:

Owning complex features and technical problems end-to-end
Designing and implementing scalable, maintainable solutions
Contributing to architectural decisions and the technical direction of the team
Improving the structure of an established codebase and reducing technical debt
Helping evolve boundaries and modularity within the application
Sparring with and mentoring other developers
Working closely with Product Management and Design to understand problems and find the right solutions
Bringing new ideas, technologies, and development practices into the team when they create real value

We expect experienced developers to have opinions, challenge existing solutions, and be comfortable having their own ideas challenged in return.

AI-assisted software development

We are significantly increasing our focus on AI-assisted development across Dalux.

We are actively exploring how AI can improve the software development lifecycle – from understanding requirements and exploring technical approaches to coding, testing, review, debugging, refactoring, and automation.

The Tender team is already experimenting with how these tools can improve its day-to-day development work.

As an experienced developer, we want you to take an active role in that development: experimenting with new workflows, critically evaluating their value, sharing what works, and helping establish good engineering practices around AI-assisted development.

Practical experience using AI as part of your development workflow is an advantage. More importantly, you should be curious about how these tools are changing software engineering and willing to continue evolving your own way of working.

Technologies we work with

Tender is a full-stack product area primarily built with:

C# / .NET
Angular / TypeScript
MSSQL
Elasticsearch

Our wider platform runs on a distributed cloud architecture using AWS.

Experience with our exact technology stack is useful, but strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand and improve complex systems matter more.

What would make you a particularly strong match?

We are looking for an experienced software developer with strong technical fundamentals and the ability to influence the software around you.

For this particular team, we would especially value:

Strong professional experience with C# and .NET
Experience improving or modernizing established software systems
An understanding of Domain-Driven Design, modular architecture, or similar approaches to structuring complex applications
Experience mentoring or providing technical sparring to other developers
Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools and workflows

You do not need to match every point.

Technical judgment, curiosity, and the ability to make an established product better are more important than having worked with exactly the same technologies or architectural patterns before.

Product development at Dalux

Our product teams bring developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers together.

Developers are expected to understand the problem being solved and contribute to finding the solution – not simply implement specifications handed to them.

As an experienced developer, you will have an important voice in balancing user value, usability, technical feasibility, business viability, and long-term technical health.

Our products are relied upon by professionals worldwide, making performance, stability, maintainability, and quality important parts of everyday engineering.

What You Can Expect From Dalux

Dalux is a software company at heart.

As an experienced developer, you can expect:

Significant ownership of the software you build
Real influence on technical solutions and engineering practices
Skilled colleagues who enjoy technical discussions
Close collaboration between Engineering, Product Management, and Design
Short paths from technical ideas to decisions and implementation
Opportunities to improve an established product and architecture
An environment actively investing in AI-assisted software development
High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems
A social workplace with monthly events and employee-driven clubs

All Dalux software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen. Working together in person is an important part of how we collaborate, share knowledge, and make decisions quickly.

About Dalux

Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, Dalux develops user-friendly software used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house, giving our developers the opportunity to influence both the products and the technology behind them.

Interested?

If you are looking for a role where you can remain hands-on while gaining greater technical influence and helping evolve an established product and architecture, we would like to hear from you.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact IT Talent Acquisition Specialist Sara at sni@dalux.com.

We are looking for a new colleague to join our talented Technology team based at our Vejle office.

We foster a developer-friendly culture where innovation isn’t just encouraged; it’s expected. You’ll have access to modern, AI-powered tools to enhance productivity and streamline your daily work.
