Work in a dynamic and international environment with experienced and skilled colleagues
Design, develop, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable solutions across backend, web frontend, and mobile, using engineering best practices and design patterns.
Drive a culture of “you build it – you own it” mentality
Identify and act on areas for your own personal development
Mentor and coach co-workers on topics that you master.

Strong hands-on experience building backend services with .NET and C#
Sound knowledge of object-oriented programming and experience working with databases
The ability to troubleshoot problems and take ownership of software in production
A collaborative and adaptable mindset, with a focus on shared ownership and continuous improvement

AutoProff was founded in 2013 by the experienced car dealer Jesper Ratza in Denmark. The aim was to digitalize B2B used car trading, helping car dealers increase sales and improve profits.

At AutoProff, we specialize in providing online B2B used-car dealing solutions designed to improve the buying and selling experience for professional car dealers and their customers.

The Applications Development Senior Programmer Analyst is a key technical role within the Futures Clearing Technology group at Citigroup. This dynamic, fast-paced team delivers low-latency, high-performance, straight-through processing (STP) solutions for exchange-traded derivatives. The platform handles trade allocations, clearing, and position management for Futures and Options across 22 clearinghouses globally.

We are seeking an exceptionally strong, hands-on senior developer for our Singapore team. In this role, you will collaborate with global development teams to architect, design, and deliver cutting-edge solutions. Your primary focus will be on delivering book-of-work items related to margin payment automation, fees and commissions automation, and robust position limits monitoring. You will build resilient, reusable libraries and components, ensuring the platform remains modern, scalable, and aligned with evolving technologies.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Design: Architect, design, and implement resilient, stateless, and highly scalable microservices and APIs, ensuring they conform to Citi’s technical standards and blueprint.
Microservices Development: Develop reusable software components within a cloud-native, microservices-based architecture to support core clearing functions, margin payments, and position limits management.
Hands-on Coding: Write clean, high-quality, and secure code utilizing Java and modern frameworks. Develop high-performing front-end screens (Angular) utilizing in-house libraries with an emphasis on design patterns and reusability.
Position Limits & Clearing Logic: Design and implement business logic to handle complex position limits (including exchange-mandated, regulatory, and house limits) and straight-through processing of futures clearing flows.
DevOps & CI/CD: Implement and maintain automated build, test, and deployment pipelines utilizing Citi’s modern DevOps toolchain (Bitbucket, Jenkins, OpenShift).
Quality & Test Automation: Partner closely with QA engineers to drive test automation efforts early in the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
Collaboration & Mentorship: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to build shared libraries. Mentor and coach junior team members, enforcing governance around development and testing standards.

Required Technical Skills

Java Expertise: Highly skilled and hands-on with Java (Core Java, Multithreading, Concurrency) and the Spring Ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security).
Microservices Architecture: Strong, demonstrated experience in designing, developing, and deploying distributed, event-driven microservice-based architectures.
Containerization & Orchestration: Highly skilled in deploying and managing cloud-native applications on Docker and OpenShift/Kubernetes platforms.

Futures Clearing: Decent functional understanding of the exchange-traded derivatives (ETD) trade lifecycle, clearing workflows, trade allocations, and integrations with global clearinghouses.

Application Security: Experience implementing security protocols and standards (OAuth, TLS/SSL, SSH, SFTP, and PKI).

Software Engineer

Despre noi

Suntem un start-up care sprijină SOLOprenorii în drumul lor spre succes. Vrem să ajungem cât mai curând la 100.000 de clienți activi. Misiunea noastră este să transformăm birocrația într-un sistem simplu, digital și automatizat.

Despre ce este rolul?

Construim un produs folosit deja de zeci de mii de oameni și vrem să-l ducem la următorul nivel.

Problema pe care o rezolvăm nu e simplă: legislație complicată, multe excepții și așteptări mari de la utilizatori.

Căutăm un engineer care vrea să contribuie la soluții reale și să crească într-un mediu cu impact direct în produs.

Misiunea ta în acest rol

Vei lucra pe probleme reale ale utilizatorilor noștri , unele bine definite, altele în curs de clarificare
Vei contribui la implementarea și îmbunătățirea sistemelor existente
Vei colabora cu echipa pentru a livra funcționalități în producție
Vei participa la decizii tehnice și vei învăța cum să le iei în timp
Vei folosi AI în workflow-ul tău pentru a crește viteza și calitatea

Ce ne dorim de la tine

2–4 ani experiență în dezvoltare software;
Experiență cu backend (ideal .NET Core, dar nu obligatoriu);
Experiență cu baze de date relaționale și modelare de date;
Capacitatea de a lucra pe probleme care nu sunt complet definite;
Interes pentru produs și modul în care este folosit de utilizatori;
Te folosești de AI (Cursor, Claude, Copilot sau similar) pentru a-ți îmbunătăți modul de lucru și înveți să validezi output-ul.

Ce oferim

Salariu competitiv (în funcție de nivel);
Zile nelimitate de concediu (pe care le și folosim);
Program flexibil;
Abonament premium la clinicile medicale Regina Maria;
Abonament Bookster;
Acces la tool-uri AI (Claude, Cursor, Copilot etc.) și buget de utilizare;
Lucrăm hibrid din București. Poți lucra până la 2 zile pe săptămână de acasă. În perioada de probă, te așteptăm zilnic la birou: e cea mai rapidă cale să înțelegi contextul, să cunoști echipa, și să ajungi să livrezi pe cont propriu.

Despre cum lucrăm în general

Modul În Care Lucrăm Este Influențat De Valorile În Care Credem Și Pe Care Ne Propunem Să Le Aplicăm În Tot Ce Facem

Creșterea continuă și accelerată e ceva fundamental - ne așteptăm de la fiecare coleg să își dorească să se dezvolte și să profite pe deplin de toate resursele pe care le punem la dispoziție pentru învățare. Regular

1. Présentation de l’ETNIC

L’ETNIC (Entreprise pour les Technologies de l’Information et de la Communication) est l’opérateur informatique de la Fédération Wallonie-Bruxelles. Organisme d’intérêt public, l’ETNIC a pour mission de concevoir, développer, maintenir et faire évoluer les systèmes d’information et les infrastructures technologiques au service des administrations et établissements de la FWB.

Acteur central de la transformation numérique du secteur public francophone belge, l’ETNIC intervient dans des domaines variés tels que :

La gestion des infrastructures IT (réseaux, sécurité, data centers, cloud),
Le développement d’applications métiers sur mesure,
L’accompagnement des projets digitaux (analyse fonctionnelle, UX/UI, gestion de projet),
La cybersécurité et la protection des données,
Le support utilisateurs et la formation.

Dans un souci constant d’innovation, de performance et de service public, l’ETNIC collabore régulièrement avec des partenaires externes pour renforcer ses équipes à travers des missions de consultance IT. Ces collaborations s’inscrivent dans un cadre éthique, professionnel et orienté vers la qualité et l’impact concret des solutions livrées

2. Mission

Dans le cadre du programme ZEPHYR de l’Office de la Naissance et de l’Enfance (ONE)
, la mission d’Application Architect / Leader Technique couvre de nombreux aspects tels que l’élaboration de propositions d'architecture applicative, le développement, l'expertise technique, l'identification de solutions pour l’implémentation de systèmes complexes.

En tant qu’Application Architect / Leader technique, vous êtes responsable de l’implémentation de la solution, de la qualité du code et de la cohérence technique, des performances et des livraisons du produit. En tant que responsable du développement des applications, vous travaillez en collaboration avec les analystes fonctionnels et métiers, les testeurs, le chef de projet et les spécialistes du middleware afin de mener à bien les implémentations. Vous êtes responsable de la qualité du livrable et de la diffusion des bonnes pratiques en matière de design et de développement.

Les projets du programme ZEPHYR :

DOMES V2

Ce projet s’inscrit dans le domaine de l’accompagnement des enfants de 0 à 6 ans. Il vise à permettre aux professionnels de l’ONE de gérer le dossier de l’enfant, de l’éditer, de créer des consultations et de planifier les rendez-vous dans l’Agenda en lien avec le suivi de l’enfant.

Prénatal V1

Dans le cadre de l’accueil et du suivi médico-social de la future mère, Prénatal V1
vise à digitaliser le dossier social de la future mère
. La solution permet de soutenir les professionnels de l’ONE dans le suivi et l’accompagnement social des futures mères, tout au long de leur parcours au sein des services concernés.

e-VAX 2.0

Le projet e-VAX 2.0 vise à remplacer l’actuelle solution e-VAX CCR et à moderniser la gestion des données de vaccination. Il permettra notamment d’améliorer la collecte et l’échange des données vaccinales, de mettre en place une carte de vaccination transversale
et de renforcer le suivi de la chaîne d’approvisionnement des vaccins. La solution contribuera également au pilotage du programme de vaccination grâce à l’exploitation des données et à des fonctionnalités d’aide à la décision.

La mission s’inscrit dans un environnement Agile / SCRUM, avec une architecture orientée services et un environnement technique principalement basé sur Java et Angular.

Le stack technologique repose sur : Angular 21, JAVA8 / JEE7, Java 21, Sprint Boot, NgRx, DB2, MySQL, Flyway, …

Les outils de build sont : Apache Maven, Git/GitLab CI/CD, Nexus.

Conception

Qualité

hybrid 60% on-site in

About the Role
The Cloud Center of Excellence (CCoE) is responsible for the design, governance and scaling of Azure and self-service platform.

We are looking for a senior engineer to help clean up the technical depth — from landing zone architecture to Terraform Enterprise module engineering, networking design and enterprise system integrations. This is a medior/senior individual contributor role: you're expected to work independently on well-defined scopes, but you'll be ramping up within an existing team structure rather than owning the full platform strategy from day one.

Current Situation
The Azure platform has grown fast — more application teams, more subscriptions, more consumers of our self-service capabilities every quarter. That
growth has been a success story, but it also means parts of our platform (governance controls, identity and access processes, networking/DNS patterns, and our Terraform Enterprise setup) were built for an earlier stage of adoption and now need to be modernized to keep pace with scale.

We're tackling this step by step: moving toward more standardized, automated and maintainable ways of working across governance, identity, networking and
infrastructure-as-code, so the platform can keep scaling without a proportional increase in manual effort.

To do that well, we're expanding the team with senior engineers who can contribute on two fronts: keeping day-to-day platform operations running smoothly for the
teams that depend on us, while also helping design and build the more standardized, scalable solutions we're moving toward.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities
Act as second-line escalation for Azure platform issues (RBAC, DNS, VNET/Private Endpoint connectivity, AD integration, Terraform Enterprise
runs) and write up root cause analyses.
Maintain and incrementally improve landing zones, archetypes, Azure Policy and naming/tagging standards; process governance exception requests.
Build, version and maintain Terraform modules; review consumer changes and evaluate Azure Verified Modules (AVM) as replacements for custom
modules.
Handle recurring IAM tickets (RBAC assignments, group memberships, access troubleshooting) and contribute to cleanup of legacy/exception-based
access.
Support DNS/connectivity requests and troubleshooting across the hybrid environment within existing patterns.
Maintain and troubleshoot existing PowerShell automation scripts used across platform operations.
Keep governance documentation current and contribute to internal Terraform Enterprise workshops and application team enablement.

Required Technical Expertise
Azure (hands-on production experience required)
Governance: management groups, subscriptions, Azure Policy (built-in and custom), RBAC design and troubleshooting.
Identity: Microsoft Entra ID — group-based access models, app registrations, managed identities, service principals.
Networking: VNET peering/hub-spoke, Private Endpoints, Private DNS Zones, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, hybrid/on-prem DNS integration.
Landing zone concepts aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) archetypes.
Exposure to Azure Databricks networking (VNet injection) is a plus.
Infrastructure as Code
Solid production-level Terraform authoring — designing, versioning and publishing modules, not just consuming them.
Terraform Enterprise or Terraform Cloud experience specifically: workspaces, private module registry, VCS-driven workflows, policy checks (Sentinel/OPA).
Familiarity with Azure Verified Modules (AVM) and module lifecycle/versioning practices.

DevOps & Automation
CI/CD pipeline experience (Azure DevOps preferred): build/release pipelines, YAML pipelines, service connections.
Scripting for automation and troubleshooting (PowerShell, Bash or Python).
Comfortable working with KQL/Log Analytics for diagnostics is a plus.

Identity & Access Management
Practical RBAC design and troubleshooting at enterprise scale (role assignments, group nesting, inheritance issues, propagation delays).
Experience managing access for both human users and service/application identities.
Understanding of access governance concepts (ownership, periodic reviews, exception handling).

Networking
Solid understanding of enterprise DNS architecture, including hybrid on- prem/cloud scenarios.
Experience troubleshooting connectivity issues across VNETs, firewalls, and hybrid links.

Prior Experience we're Looking For
4–7 years in a cloud platform engineering, DevOps or infrastructure engineering role, ideally within a large, governed enterprise (not a greenfield/startup environment).
Demonstrated experience operating (not just building) an Azure landing zone platform at scale — supporting real application teams with real tickets.
Prior role involving Terraform Enterprise/Cloud in a production capacity, ideally including module authorship and CI/CD integration.
Experience working across team boundaries (IAM, Networking, Security, external partners/vendors) to resolve platform issues.
Microsoft certifications (AZ-104, AZ-204, AZ-305, or Terraform Associate) are a strong plus but not a substitute for demonstrable hands-on experience.
Personal Characteristics
Can operate independently on a well-scoped task from day one — this is a "plug in and go"; role, not a ramp-up position.
Comfortable working in a live, legacy-entangled environment where not everything is fully standardized yet.
Detail-oriented, especially around governance, documentation and naming/tagging consistency.
Good communicator — able to support application teams directly without needing everything translated by the platform lead.
Takes ownership of tickets/incidents end-to-end rather than escalating prematurely.

Scientific Manager – Machine Learning Engineering (Computational Biology)

Ghent, Belgium (hybrid)

Who are we?

Excelra is a leader in biopharma data and analytics, that uniquely blends scientific understanding with technological expertise. This dual mastery empowers innovative drug discovery and development, transforming research data into actionable insights for groundbreaking discovery.

We have global locations in Ghent (Belgium), London (UK), Utrecht (The Netherlands), Boston/SFO (US) and Hyderabad (India).

www.excelra.com

About the role

We are hiring a Scientific Manager to take ownership of the machine learning and experimental design pipelines behind our customer’s genomic target prediction work. Much of this currently lives in individual scripts maintained by individual scientists. Your job is to turn it into an automated, version-controlled and reproducible platform the whole team can rely on – and to keep it scientifically sound by working shoulder to shoulder with our customer’s wet-lab and computational biology colleagues.

This is a hands-on engineering role in a scientific environment. You will spend more of your time building, automating and hardening pipelines than running individual analyses, so we are looking for someone who is as comfortable with Git, containers and workflow managers as with genomics data.

What will you do?

Automate and professionalize internal ML and experimental design pipelines for genomic target prediction.
Migrate existing scripts and notebooks into a production-ready, version-controlled codebase.
Reduce the manual input required for dataset preparation, settings configuration and pipeline execution.
Integrate pipelines into existing digital infrastructure, including AWS and HPC environments.
Implement version control, testing and reproducibility standards across ML workflows, and help the team adopt them.
Collaborate closely with wet-lab and computational biology colleagues to make sure pipelines meet real scientific requirements.
Run several projects in parallel, (re)assigning tasks as priorities shift, and present results concisely to stakeholders inside and outside your domain.

What do you bring?

A PhD in bioscience engineering, bioinformatics, computer science or machine learning engineering – or an MSc with 5+ years of equivalent experience. You can demonstrate this through peer-reviewed publications, contributions to public code repositories or relevant project work.
Strong Python, and the habit of writing code that colleagues can read, test and re-run.
Proven experience taking analysis code into production: version control with Git, code review, packaging, containerization (Docker, Singularity/Apptainer) and automated testing or CI/CD.
Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration – Nextflow, Snakemake or equivalent.
Experience running workloads on cloud infrastructure (AWS) and/or HPC clusters (e.g. SLURM).
Solid grounding in statistical modelling and machine learning applied to biological data, including model evaluation and experiment tracking.
The ability to translate between engineering and bench science, and to work with scientists who are not engineers.
You are eligible to live and work in Belgium.

Nice to have

Experience with genomics and transcriptomics data (RNAseq, single-cell, spatial, WES/WGS, …).
R alongside Python.
Experiment tracking and model registry tooling (MLflow, Weights & Biases) or infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
Experience in a client-facing, consulting or CRO setting.

Who are you?

You enjoy project-based work and have a strong analytical mindset.
You enjoy working in a multidisciplinary environment with people of diverse professional backgrounds (IT, (molecular) biology, genomics, engineering, etc.).
You are communicative and customer focused.
You are fluent in English, both written and verbally.
You take initiative and have an eye for new opportunities.

What do we offer?

A challenging job environment with advancement opportunities.
Flexible hybrid working in an international (global) setting: largely home-based, with the option to work alongside colleagues in our Ghent office and occasional visits to our customers on site.
A dynamic company with an open culture, easy communication and an ambitious vision.
A rich & global team with a mix of backgrounds, experiences and expertise.
Independence and flexibility.
An attractive salary package with extra-legal benefits.

Interested?

Please send your resume and motivation letter to Helen De Block, HR Director: helen.deblock@excelra.com

jobs.title: Software Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Software Tester / Test Manager – Dynamics 365 & Power Platform

About the Role

Nexplore is seeking an experienced Software Testing professional at Professional to Senior level to support quality assurance within the Dynamics & Power Platform environment. You will combine hands-on testing in agile delivery teams with classic test management responsibilities, helping ensure reliable, end-user-ready software.
In this role, you will think beyond standard scenarios, identify risks and edge cases, and translate requirements into clear, testable cases. You will work closely with Requirements Engineering, UX, Development, Operations, and business teams in a self-organized, holacratic organization.

Key Responsibilities

Define test objectives, test types, acceptance criteria, and regression-ready test sets for Dynamics 365 workflows, forms, and integrations.
Create and maintain test strategies, test concepts, and test plans from an end-to-end testing perspective through release testing.
Perform manual testing during agile sprints and beyond, including standard, edge-case, and less obvious test paths.
Document test results clearly and comprehensively.
Manage test plans, test cases, and test runs using Azure DevOps, Jira Xray, or comparable tools.
Coordinate and support business testing and release readiness activities.
Establish quality standards within the team, including Definition of Done, test-case guidelines, and bug templates.
Support customers in increasing their testing maturity.
Work with interdisciplinary teams to turn requirements into clear, verifiable test cases and deliver software suitable for end users.
Take responsibility for the Tester role within the Dynamics & Power Platform area; additional roles may be available based on suitability, interest, and capacity.

Required Qualifications

Practical experience in software testing, including manual testing, in agile environments.
Confidence creating test cases and test strategies.
Experience with Azure DevOps/TFS, including Boards and Test Plans, or comparable tools.
Experience with Dynamics 365 CE/CRM.
Ability to quickly learn low-code and Power Platform topics.
Structured and detail-oriented working style.
Very good German and good English language skills.
Residence in Switzerland.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with test automation.
Experience with API testing.
Experience with automated test-data generation.
ISTQB CTFL certification or a higher ISTQB certification.
Knowledge of Power Platform and Azure.

Skills & Competencies

Manual software testing and test management.
Test strategy, test planning, test-case design, and regression testing.
End-to-end testing, release testing, and release readiness.
Dynamics 365 CE/CRM and low-code platform testing.
Azure DevOps/TFS, Jira Xray, or comparable test-management tools.
Defect documentation, quality standards, and quality assurance.
Risk identification, analytical thinking, and problem-solving.
Cross-functional collaboration and communication.
Agile ways of working and self-organization.

Education & Experience

Education

No specific formal education requirement is stated.

Experience

Practical software-testing experience in agile environments.
Experience creating test cases and test strategies.
Experience with Azure DevOps/TFS or comparable tools.
Experience with Dynamics 365 CE/CRM.

Work Arrangement & Schedule

Flexible workload: 60% to 100%.
Work locations: Thun, Bern, Basel, customer locations, or remote home office.
No fixed office days are specified.
Employees can organize where and when they work based on their tasks.
Employment type, weekly hours, weekend requirements, and start date are not specified.

Compensation & Benefits

Opportunity to shape your role and take on additional roles within Nexplore.
Professional and personal development through on- and off-the-job learning, feedback, and knowledge sharing.
Collaborative culture based on trust, open exchange, and mutual challenge.
Varied work across customers, tasks, and challenges.
Team events.
Nexplore has been recognized multiple times as a Kununu Top Company.

At Funstage, our players come first. The Backend team creates the technology behind our social casino games, from bonus engines and progression systems to leaderboards, battle passes and real-time gameplay that keep players coming back for another round.

As a Senior .NET Backend Developer, this is a chance to turn great game ideas into reality, tackle exciting challenges at scale, and see your work make a real difference to the player experience. From idea to production, there’s plenty of room to shape how things are built, bring fresh ideas to the table, and have fun solving tricky technical problems along the way.

Your tasks

Analyse

Turn technical discussions and stakeholder feedback, including insights from Customer Support and CRM, into clear, actionable requirements and practical solutions
Explore, evaluate, and manage libraries and tools that help the team choose the right solution for each project

Develop

Design and build optimised distributed backend systems and real-time gaming features capable of handling hundreds of thousands of operations per second and up to 50.000 simultaneous players
Create and optimise databases and ETL pipelines to keep data reliable and systems performing at their best
Bring new features to life in our Vue.js Admin Panel by implementing their configuration

Test

Create and maintain automated and performance tests that keep features reliable under pressure
Develop and maintain Vue.js Test-Client features that make backend features easy to test and validate

Deploy

Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and fast, reliable rollback strategies
Work with web and mobile frontend teams to integrate backend services seamlessly across their platforms

Maintain

Build and continuously improve Kubernetes infrastructure and monitoring across Azure and local development environments
Maintain security protocols covering user roles, access controls, encryption, and security updates
Document incidents from root cause through resolution and post-mortem analysis, turning issues into opportunities to improve
Share your expertise with your colleagues and improve the overall team quality

Tools

The Team

Architecture is a team effort. New solutions are discussed openly and shaped together, with team buy-in before development begins
Code reviews are part of how we grow. Every pull request is reviewed by the rest of the team within a few hours, helping us maintain quality while sharing knowledge along the way

Own the full picture. Everyone builds a strong understanding of our Kubernetes components and CI/CD, so infrastructure knowledge is shared across the team

Your profile

Professional experience working with .NET technologies, with .NET 5+ experience preferred
Strong knowledge of database technologies, with experience across SQL and NoSQL preferred
Familiarity with the API technologies that connect our backend to frontend experiences, including REST, GraphQL, and WebSockets
Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native technologies
Understanding of distributed systems and the challenges of building technology capable of supporting millions of players worldwide

Strong product thinking, with the ability to turn stakeholder needs into clear and effective technical requirements
Collaborative mindset with experience in pair programming, team workshops, knowledge sharing, and supporting the growth of others
Agile mindset and a pragmatic approach to building solid, evolvable solutions
Confident communicating and collaborating in English, both written and spoken

Flexible working hours and a hybrid model that fit your lifestyle, backed by a strong culture of work-life balance

A welcoming office atmosphere at our Vienna HQ with daily fresh fruit, a wide range of teas, fair-trade coffee, and meals at our company-subsidized restaurant

Plenty of ways to stay active and connected, from MyClubs app points to regular sports and company events

jobs.title: Microsoft Power Platform Architect (m/f/d) – Tieto Tech Consulting
jobs.description:
Job Description

Do you want to turn business challenges into smart, scalable solutions with Microsoft Power Platform? At Tieto Tech Consulting, we work at the intersection of technology, consulting, and customer value - helping organizations automate processes and build modern digital solutions that make daily work easier and more impactful.

With over 8,000 colleagues worldwide and around 300 colleagues in the DACH region, we combine industry insight, software engineering, cloud expertise, data capabilities, and enterprise solutions know-how to help our customers design, build, and run their digital businesses.

We are looking for a Microsoft Power Platform Architect who can take ownership of enterprise-level solution architectures, guide customers in strategic technology decisions, and translate complex business needs into scalable, secure and future-ready Microsoft ecosystem solutions. If you are passionate about architecture, governance, cloud technologies and creating sustainable business value with Power Platform, this role offers the opportunity to shape impactful solutions together with skilled colleagues and forward-thinking customers.

When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Microsoft Power Platform Architect, you

Define and own end-to-end Power Platform architectures, ensuring scalable, secure and sustainable solution designs across Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and Power Pages
Advise customers on best practices for Power Platform governance and lifecycle management
Lead the architectural integration of Power Platform solutions into broader Microsoft 365 and Azure ecosystems, aligning technical decisions with enterprise standards and customer strategy
Facilitate architecture workshops, guide decision-making with customers and provide expert recommendations on solution design, governance and technical roadmaps
Stay up-to-date with Microsoft certifications and contribute to internal capability building

Who We Are Looking For

We value diverse backgrounds and welcome candidates who bring:

5+ years of hands-on experience in a similar role
Very good knowledge of Cloud Enterprise Architecture, Power Platform, Azure and Azure AI ecosystems
A completed degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a comparable qualification
Certifications such as PL-200, PL-400, PL-600 or PL-900 are a plus
Hands-on knowledge of Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, and GPT-based solutions
Strong understanding of low-code/no-code development principles
Good programming skills, preferably with C#/.NET
Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions
A consulting mindset and strong communication skills in both German and English
Passion for continuous learning and staying up-to-date with new developments

As an individual, you are a team player who takes initiative and ownership. You communicate clearly, organize your work effectively, and enjoy solving complex challenges. You’re eager to learn and share knowledge, and you thrive in a fast-evolving technology landscape.

We offer

Collaboration with highly skilled experts across Europe and beyond
A culture built on trust, collaboration, and continuous learning
Flexible hybrid working models and modern ways of working
Benefits like laptop and smartphone also for private use, health programs, team events, excellent public transport connection, food vouchers, contribution to the costs of the Austrian “Klimaticket”, fresh fruits, the perfect environment to prosper professionally, and a lot more
Continuous professional development and international career opportunities
An attractive compensation package including performance-based incentives

The monthly gross salary for this position will start from € 4.476,00 (based on IT collective agreement, ST1 Erfahrungsstufe) on a full-time basis, depending on your qualifications and experience. Our aim is to provide you with a salary package that is both competitive and reflective of your relevant experience, while also aligning with current market standards.

Did we get you inspired?

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would love to hear from you. Please attach your CV or LinkedIn profile, and we will get in touch.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact us: careers.austria@tieto.com.

We’re also happy to connect you with one of your future colleagues for an informal conversation. It’s a great opportunity to hear first-hand what the role looks like, how we work and what it’s like to be part of the team.

Please note that while we are happy to answer questions via email, we can only consider applications submitted through our online application system and therefore cannot accept applications sent directly by email.

Locations:
Vienna, Linz, Graz

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Tieto only communicates via @tieto.com email addresses.
We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.

NUESTRO CLIENTE

Compañía tecnológica de capital privado, multinacional inglesa con fuerte presencia en Europa, especializada en servicios IT, cloud, infraestructura, ciberseguridad, workplace, managed services y transformación digital para grandes organizaciones. Con presencia en España desde hace más de 25 años. Global y large accounts.

EL PROYECTO

En el marco de su crecimiento en España (y global), la compañía está impulsando una nueva unidad de negocio especializada en Inteligencia Artificial
, concebida como una línea estratégica de alto impacto dentro del grupo. Se trata de una apuesta corporativa con visibilidad internacional, conectada con HQ y con participación activa en el CoE global de IA de la compañía.
Se trata de una posición de nueva creación
que reportará directamente al Director de la Unidad de Negocio de IA en España. Su misión será clave para convertir la estrategia de IA en soluciones reales, vendibles, escalables y ejecutables para clientes enterprise.

El rol tendrá una doble dimensión especialmente atractiva. Por un lado, será una figura clave de cara al mercado, acompañando a clientes en la identificación de casos de uso, diseño de arquitecturas, construcción de propuestas, desarrollo de PoCs/PoVs y defensa técnica de soluciones de IA ante interlocutores C-Level. Por otro, tendrá también un papel innovador dentro de la propia organización, ayudando a desarrollar capacidades, metodologías, arquitecturas de referencia, aceleradores y modelos de servicio que permitan consolidar la práctica de IA en España.
Es una oportunidad especialmente interesante para un perfil que quiera participar en la construcción de una práctica de IA desde una fase inicial, con respaldo internacional, exposición a clientes estratégicos y capacidad real de influir en la propuesta de valor de la compañía.

PRINCIPALES FUNCIONES

Acompañar a los equipos comerciales y account managers en sesiones de discovery con clientes, identificando necesidades, pain points, casos de uso y criterios técnicos de decisión.
Diseñar arquitecturas de soluciones Data & AI basadas en plataformas cloud y tecnologías como Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Copilot Studio, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Mistral AI u otras soluciones de IA privada o soberana.
Elaborar propuestas técnicas, Statements of Work, planes de PoC/PoV, estimaciones de esfuerzo, arquitecturas de referencia y documentación de solución.
Liderar respuestas técnicas a RFPs y RFIs, en coordinación con equipos de bid management, comercial, cloud, infraestructura, ciberseguridad y delivery.
Preparar y defender presentaciones técnicas, workshops de arquitectura, demos y sesiones ejecutivas ante CIOs, CTOs, responsables de datos, innovación, tecnología y negocio.
Diseñar patrones reutilizables para casos de uso habituales como Document Intelligence, Conversational AI, Knowledge Mining, RAG, automatización mediante agentes y procesos de IA aplicada.
Participar en la construcción de PoCs, PoVs, prototipos y aceleradores técnicos que permitan validar la viabilidad de la solución y demostrar valor de negocio.
Definir especificaciones técnicas para servicios gestionados de IA, incluyendo procedimientos operativos, monitorización, SLAs, LLMOps, AIOps y traspaso a equipos de delivery.
Garantizar que las soluciones diseñadas cumplen criterios de seguridad, privacidad, gobierno del dato, responsible AI y frameworks corporativos de cloud landing zones.
Colaborar activamente con el Centro de Excelencia Global de IA, incorporando buenas prácticas, metodologías, arquitecturas de referencia y capacidades diferenciales del grupo.
Mantenerse actualizado/a sobre nuevas herramientas, modelos, frameworks de orquestación y tendencias de mercado en el ámbito de IA generativa, agentes, RAG, MLOps/LLMOps y cloud AI.

PERFIL REQUERIDO

Buscamos un perfil técnico-consultivo con experiencia en arquitectura de soluciones Data & AI, preventa técnica o consultoría tecnológica, idealmente en compañías de servicios IT, integradores, consultoras tecnológicas, partners cloud, hyperscalers o empresas especializadas en datos e inteligencia artificial.

Experiencia aproximada de 4 a 7 años, o superior, en Data & AI Solution Architecture, Technical Presales, Cloud AI Architecture, Data Platform Architecture o consultoría tecnológica especializada.
Conocimiento sólido de tecnologías del ecosistema Microsoft, especialmente Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Copilot Studio y Azure AI Document Intelligence.
Experiencia o conocimiento práctico de otras plataformas como AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, Google Vertex AI o soluciones de Private/Sovereign AI.
Experiencia en diseño de arquitecturas RAG, patrones de orquestación de IA y frameworks como Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, LangChain o equivalentes.
Conocimiento de integración vía APIs, DevOps/MLOps, plataformas de datos, Azure Data Lake, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks o entornos similares.

Nivel alto de español e inglés (imprescindible)
Valorable certificación Azure AI Engineer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert o equivalentes.

QUÉ OFRECE ESTA OPORTUNIDAD

Incorporación a una unidad de IA de nueva creación dentro de una compañía tecnológica internacional consolidada.

jobs.title: Solution Architect – Industrial Data & Integration
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

SistelGroup delivers turnkey PLC, SCADA and OT data contextualization solutions for the manufacturing industry. For more than 30 years we have helped pharmaceutical, chemical, and food & beverage manufacturers run plants that are more efficient, safer and fully traceable.
We work as a partner, not a supplier. We learn our customers’ processes, we stay with them through the full life of a solution, and we are the people they call when something matters. That is why our clients stay with us for decades.
When you join us, you will work on international projects with advanced Industry 4.0 and digitalization technologies for leading manufacturing companies. You will also build your career in a group that covers both industrial automation and digital transformation for the manufacturing industry.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Solution Architect to lead the technical direction of our industrial data and integration work. This is a hands-on architecture role, focused on Unified Namespace, industrial connectivity and data contextualization. You will design and build the architectures that connect the plant floor to business systems (SCADA, MES, ERP, warehousing systems, LIMS), and you will write the reference architecture and the standards that our engineers follow. Ignition is a particular focus: it is the platform we build most of these solutions on.
You are hands-on with the technology. You build proofs of concept, prototypes and demonstrations: to prove a design works, to show a client what is possible, and to give our engineers a working reference to learn from. Our project teams carry out the implementation and commissioning, and part of the Solution Architect role is to train them to do it well.
Much of this work is about context. A plant produces millions of values every day, but a value on its own means very little. Context is what turns it into insightful information: which equipment produced it, on which line, during which batch and for which product, and how it connects to the order in the ERP system and the result in the laboratory. You design the models, the naming and the relationships that carry that meaning, so that the same data serves an operator, a quality reviewer and a data scientist without anyone having to guess what it refers to.
You will work with our commercial team from the first client conversations, helping turn a business problem into a design, a demonstration, and a proposal. On projects: you are involved in the early stages — design, architecture and the technical decisions that shape the work — and then hand over to the delivery team. Most of our clients work in regulated industries, which means clear documentation and traceable design decisions are key.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Architecture and design

Design Unified Namespace architectures for plant data: namespace and topic structure, information models, and the context that gives each value its meaning.
Design the data models behind the architecture: equipment and site hierarchies, product and batch genealogy, and the relationships between assets, processes and quality results, using recognized models ISA-95 and ISA-88.
Design integrations between plant systems and business systems: PLC, SCADA, ERP, MES, LIMS, historians and data platforms.
Assess legacy plant and laboratory environments and design the modernization path for them.
Choose the technologies, and write reference architecture and design standards for this work.

Proofs of concept and integration

Build proofs of concept, prototypes and reference implementations that prove a design works before a project commits to it.
Build and prove data flows with MQTT, Sparkplug B, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Work with Ignition and similar platforms as the plant-side layer of these architectures.
Build prototypes of data-driven applications on top of the architecture: equipment monitoring, predictive maintenance, and batch reporting.
Integrate with ERP and MES using standard message formats such as B2MML, so that production orders, confirmations and quality results flow in both directions.
Make plant data findable and “end user friendly” to people who did not build the system, through consistent naming, documented models and clear metadata.
Connect to business and laboratory systems: SAP and other ERP systems, MES platforms, LIMS and quality systems.

Pre-sales and client consulting

Work with our commercial team during early client conversations: understand the business problem before designing anything.
Run technical workshops with clients, design the solution, and present it clearly to both engineers and management.
Build the demonstrations and solution concepts that our commercial team uses in client meetings.
Contribute to development of technical proposals, solution designs and estimates together with our commercial team.

Technical expertise and knowledge sharing

Train engineers to implement and commission the solutions you design, and build the team’s capability in Ignition, MQTT, industrial data connectivity, and data contextualization concepts.
Lead the design phase of new projects, then hand over to the delivery team with the documentation and guidance they need.

REQUIREMENTS

Degree in engineering, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
8+ years of experience in industrial automation, industrial software or IT/OT integration, including several years in an architecture or solution design role.
Deep hands-on experience with Ignition (Inductive Automation): you build prototypes and demonstrations yourself, and you are comfortable working in the tools rather than only specifying them.
Proven experience designing and integrating plant-to-enterprise architectures in real production environments: Unified Namespace, PLC, DCS, SCADA, MES, ERP and LIMS.
Strong experience with MQTT, Sparkplug B, OPC UA, and REST APIs.
Proven experience modelling and contextualizing industrial data: hierarchies, naming conventions, metadata and the relationships between equipment, process and product.
Strong SQL skills, and at least one scripting language, preferably Python.
Experience delivering in GMP or other regulated environments, with working knowledge of GAMP 5, EU GMP Annex 11, 21 CFR Part 11.
The ability to explain a complex architecture simply, to engineers and to managers.
Commercial skills: effort estimation, and technical workshop facilitation.
English, spoken and written. Spanish is a plus.

DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE AND CERTIFICATIONS

The following skills are nice-to-have and will support the innovative engineering initiatives at our company.
Data-driven manufacturing applications: predictive maintenance, equipment monitoring, OEE, energy monitoring solutions, batch reporting and yield, golden batch.
MQTT broker platforms: HiveMQ, or the Cirrus Link modules for Ignition.
Cloud knowledge, preferably Azure.
Historians and industrial data platforms: AVEVA OSI PI, AspenTech Inmation, or similar.
Time-series and non-relational databases (MongoDB, InfluxDB, or similar).
Containers, CI/CD and version control (Docker, Kubernetes, Git).
Data analysis and dashboards (Power BI, Grafana or similar).
OT network and security design: segmentation, industrial DMZ, and ISA/IEC 62443 knowledge or certification.
MES platforms: Ignition Sepasoft, Körber PAS-X, Siemens Opcenter, or similar.
Multi-site standardization, or defining a technical service offering: creating a reference architecture or data model template and rolling it out across several plants or projects.
Regulatory awareness for industrial data: the EU GMP Annex 11 revision, and Annex 22 on artificial intelligence in GMP.

WHAT WE OFFER

A builder’s role with technical ownership: you design it, you prove it, and you see it become part of how the company works.
Training programs with our technology partners.
A direct line to the business: you work with our commercial team and see your designs turn into won projects.
Large international pharmaceutical clients and genuinely complex plants.
A specialized and collaborative technical team, and 30+ years of plant knowledge behind you. We are a people-oriented company, with special focus on ensuring the best environment for our engineers to work and collaborate.
Competitive salary according to your experience.
Flexible working hours and hybrid work.

Our commitment to respect, transparency, and simplicity means you can trust us to always choose to do the right thing.

As a trusted partner for purpose-built AI and intelligent automation, we solve highly complex problems for our enterprise customers and put their information to work to transform the way they do business. Over 10,000 customers trust ABBYY, including many Fortune 500 ones. You will work on further developing a portfolio already containing client names such as DHL, Johnson & Johnson, FDA, DMV, PwC, KeyBank, Spotify, and H&R BLOCK.

About the role:

ABBYY Vantage is our flagship Document AI platform – a cloud-native, microservices-based product that combines purpose-built AI, OCR, NLP, and direct LLM integration to help enterprise customers extract, classify, and act on data from any document. Vantage 3.0, our latest release, introduces native Azure OpenAI integration, enterprise-grade compliance and redaction, a real-time analytics dashboard, and a growing library of pre-configured AI skills. Over 10,000 customers trust ABBYY – including Fortune 500 companies like DHL, Johnson & Johnson, FDA, PwC, KeyBank, Spotify, and H&R Block – to automate their most complex document workflows.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Vantage engineering team. You will be a hands-on contributor building and evolving the services that power Vantage's document AI capabilities – from OCR pipelines and skill training workflows to API integrations and analytics infrastructure. You bring strong engineering fundamentals, a quality-first mindset, and a drive to deliver reliable, scalable software in a cloud-native environment.

Job Responsibilities:

End-to-End Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy features and services within the Vantage platform, contributing to areas such as document processing pipelines, AI skill management, cloud infrastructure, and API layers.
Code Quality: Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code; actively participate in code reviews and champion engineering best practices across your team.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, UX designers, ML engineers, and fellow software engineers to translate Vantage feature requirements into well-architected solutions.
Continuous Improvement: Identify and surface improvements to existing Vantage services, tooling, and delivery workflows; contribute to reducing technical debt and increasing engineering velocity.
System Reliability: Monitor the health and performance of Vantage cloud services; investigate and resolve production incidents in a timely manner.
Technical Growth: Stay current with advances in Document AI, cloud-native patterns, and GenAI integration approaches that could enhance the Vantage platform.

Job Requirements:

5–9 years of professional software engineering experience with deep expertise in C# .NET
Demonstrated ability to work with multiple programming languages, and willingness to work with both C# .NET and C++
Proven experience designing, implementing, and operating CI/CD pipelines for building, testing, and deploying workflows using GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps Pipelines
Good understanding of microservices architecture, distributed system design, and cloud-native patterns at enterprise scale
Demonstrated track record of delivering high-quality, testable code
Strong analytical and debugging skills with the ability to investigate complex issues across distributed systems

Desired Qualifications

Experience in cloud, preferably using Microsoft Azure (AKS, Storage, Key Vaults, Azure SQL or equivalent)
Hands-on experience designing and operating workflow-driven systems (orchestration, retries, timeouts, and state management)
Experience integrating Machine Learning, Neural Networks or LLMs into enterprise applications and workflows
Familiarity with OCR, NLP and computer vision technologies
Comfort operating across a globally distributed engineering organization spanning multiple regions and cultures

Salary Range:

The anticipated base salary range for this position is between 19,000,000 HUF and 20,000,000 HUF annually
. Base salary ranges may vary by geographic location and relevant experience, education, certifications, and seniority compared to others performing substantially similar work. There is no guarantee that an offer will be at the top of the posted range, as compensation decisions are based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, skills, qualifications, and internal equity.

Here are some of our local benefits:

Medical benefits after 90 days
SZÉP Card allowance for recreational activities
Volunteering Time Off (VTO)
Company paid sick time up to 10 days per year

Join ABBYY, and you will:

Love How You Work

We provide remote and hybrid working options to fit all lifestyles.
We use flexible hours across most of our teams to allow you to find your own definition of balance.
Encouraging a culture of giving, we provide two paid volunteering days off every year so you can take time to contribute to the causes you care about.

Love Whom You Work With

We are a global team of 600+ colleagues, spread across 15 countries on four continents.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer – Healthcare Integrations & Systems
jobs.description:
Who is FluidAI?

FluidAI Medical is creating a paradigm shift in post-operative care, utilizing the plethora of data within the body, to help in the detection of post-operative complications at their onset. Our clinically validated platform sensing technology augments existing wound drains and catheters, providing healthcare providers with a smart monitoring tool that can support earlier detection of deadly complications and enhance the delivery of care.
We are an equal-opportunity employer and have a diverse team representation across language, ethnicity, gender and nationality.

Why join FluidAI Medical?

Mission to save lives and improve patient care with revolutionary technology that's already deployed on patients in real-world settings.
Work with a high-performing and cross-functional team that is empowered to grow, learn, and contribute across all levels of the organization.
We are a team of passionate builders and boundary-breakers that are on a singular mission to disrupt how patient care is done. We aim to succeed and perform together - as a team and as individuals.
Gain exposure across the entire technical stack, from novel sensing technologies and proprietary hardware to mobile/web software and ML algorithms.
Personal career-focused development and training with access to workshops, coursework, and experienced mentors/consultants.

Backend Engineer – Healthcare Integrations & Systems

FluidAI Medical is at the forefront of integrating data, technology, and healthcare to improve patient outcomes. Our platform generates rich, high-frequency clinical data at the bedside, and for that data to change how care is delivered it must flow reliably into the systems clinicians already use. We are expanding our team to include a Backend Engineer who can design and build the integration layer that connects our platform to hospital EHRs, laboratory and device systems, and national health data exchanges.
This role is ideal for a hands-on backend engineer with strong experience building production APIs and services, deep familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 FHIR and HL7 v2, and a track record of shipping and supporting integrations in live hospital environments. Experience with EHR vendor integration (e.g., Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner, InterSystems) and regional health information exchange requirements is highly preferred.
This position is remote but requires travel across the Middle East to collaborate with the FluidAI team, hospital IT departments, and clients.

Responsibilities

🔌 Design, build, and maintain the integration services that exchange clinical data between the FluidAI platform and hospital systems (EHRs, LIS, ADT feeds, device gateways, and national health exchanges).
🧬 Implement and maintain HL7 FHIR APIs and resources (e.g., Patient, Encounter, Observation, Device, DiagnosticReport) as well as HL7 v2 message interfaces (ADT, ORU, ORM) for inbound and outbound data flows.
🏗️ Build clean, well-tested, production-grade backend services and APIs (REST and event-driven) that are secure, observable, and resilient to the realities of hospital networks.
🗺️ Own data mapping and transformation logic between FluidAI's internal data models and external standards, including terminology mapping (LOINC, SNOMED CT, UCUM) and vendor-specific profile variations.
🔁 Develop robust interface engine and integration patterns: message queuing, retries, deduplication, acknowledgement handling, idempotency, and reconciliation.
🏥 Lead the technical side of hospital onboarding: gather interface requirements, conduct connectivity and message testing with hospital IT and EHR analysts, and support go-live and hypercare.
🔍 Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging for integration health so that message failures and data gaps are caught early and traced end-to-end.
🔐 Apply healthcare security and privacy best practices, including OAuth2/SMART on FHIR, mutual TLS, VPN connectivity, audit logging, and data minimization, in line with regional regulations (e.g., Saudi NPHIES/SeHE requirements, HIPAA, PIPEDA).
📚 Create and maintain clear technical documentation: interface specifications, FHIR implementation guides, integration runbooks, and data flow diagrams.
🤝 Partner with product, clinical, regulatory, and QA teams to ensure integrations meet clinical workflow needs and medical device software standards (e.g., IEC 62304, ISO 13485 processes).
🏃‍♂️ Participate in sprint planning and Agile ceremonies, contributing to roadmap planning and prioritization from an integrations and platform perspective.
🔧 Collaborate closely with software, hardware, data, and ML teams to expose reliable data services across the full technology stack.

Qualifications

📚 Strong hands-on experience as a Backend Engineer, Integration Engineer, or Interoperability Engineer, ideally within healthcare or medical technology.
🧬 Deep working knowledge of HL7 FHIR (R4 and/or R5), including resource modelling, profiles, extensions, search, and bulk data, and hands-on experience with FHIR servers or SDKs (e.g., HAPI FHIR, Firely, Microsoft/Azure FHIR, Google Cloud Healthcare API).
📨 Solid experience with HL7 v2.x messaging, including message structure, segments, ACK/NACK handling, and common workflows (ADT, ORU, ORM, MDM).
🔌 Experience with integration/interface engines such as Mirth Connect (NextGen Connect), Rhapsody, InterSystems, Cloverleaf, or equivalent custom pipelines.
💻 High proficiency in at least one backend language such as Python, Java/Kotlin, C#/.NET, Go, or TypeScript/Node.js, with strong API design skills (REST, OpenAPI, webhooks) and familiarity with message brokers (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, MQTT).
🗄️ Strong SQL and data modelling skills with relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle) and familiarity with NoSQL or time-series stores.
☁️ Experience deploying and operating services in cloud and hybrid environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP; Docker; Kubernetes; CI/CD; infrastructure as code), including on-premise hospital deployments.
🔐 Working knowledge of healthcare security and identity standards: OAuth2/OIDC, SMART on FHIR, TLS/mTLS, encryption at rest and in transit, and audit requirements.
🏥 Direct experience integrating with EHR vendors (Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner, MEDITECH, InterSystems TrakCare, or regional systems) and working alongside hospital IT teams is highly preferred.
🧠 Familiarity with clinical terminologies (LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD-10, UCUM) and with medical device connectivity standards (e.g., IEEE 11073, IHE profiles such as PIX/PDQ, XDS) is a strong plus.
📋 Familiarity with regulated software development practices (IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, traceability) is a plus.
🗣️ Fluent in English; Arabic is a strong plus. Ability to communicate clearly with both engineers and hospital IT and clinical stakeholders.
✈️ Must be able and willing to travel within Saudi Arabia for work, including extended periods of time.
🤝 Comfortable working in cross-functional, fast-paced, and collaborative environments.
💡 Strong problem-solving mindset with a bias toward impact, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Application Process

📞 Introductory phone call (~15 minutes).
📝 Technical & systems design working session (~1 hour).
🎤 Final interview (~45 minutes).
📜 Offer stage.

If you are passionate about making clinical data flow seamlessly between systems and want to build the integration foundations that put real-time patient insights directly into clinicians' hands, we would love to hear from you.

Job Description: Quantitative Developer, Systematic Equities

Please direct all resume submissions to QuantTalentEUR@mlp.com and reference REQ-26457 in the subject.

Millennium is a top tier global hedge fund with a strong commitment to leveraging market innovations in technology and data to deliver high-quality returns.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and entrepreneurial Lead Software Engineer to architect, build, and scale the core trading infrastructure for a newly formed quantitative trading pod. You will lead the design and deployment of systems that support systematic strategies operating across global markets and time zones.

This is a hands-on leadership role at the intersection of technology, research, and trading - you'll collaborate directly with quantitative researchers and the Senior Portfolio Manager to turn ideas into production-ready strategies.

The pod is led by a Senior Portfolio Manager with 15+ years of experience and a proven track record in alpha generation, strategy development, and risk management at top-tier quant firms. This is a unique opportunity to own the technology stack from day one, influence strategic direction, and help shape a high-performance team in a collaborative and intellectually rigorous environment.

Location

Dubai

Principal Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture
Design and maintain the trading system architecture, including components for data ingestion, signal generation, backtesting, execution, and risk management
Make decisions on technology stack, performance optimization, and scalability
Ensure the system supports reasonable latency, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant trading

Team Leadership & Collaboration
Help recruit and Lead a small team of developers (sometimes quants as well) within the pod
Work closely with the quant researchers and traders to understand strategy requirements and translate them into code
Prioritize tasks and mentor junior developers or quant devs

Strategy Implementation Support
Build and maintain research infrastructure (e.g., backtesting frameworks, simulation environments, feature stores)
Translate researchers' prototypes (e.g., in Python) into production­ grade code, often in C++, or C# for latency-sensitive components

Execution & Infrastructure
Optimize and support order execution systems, integrating with various exchanges or broker APIs
Implement real-time risk checks, monitoring, logging, and alerting tools

Data Engineering & Management
Oversee the pipeline for ingesting, cleaning, and storing data (market, alternative, internal)
Ensure data integrity and low-latency access for trading and research

DevOps & Reliability
Often take responsibility for deployment pipelines, version control, and production support
Ensure high system availability and rapid recovery in case of failures

Security & Compliance
Make sure that the pod's infrastructure adheres to firm-wide compliance and security standards
Ensure rigorous version control, code quality, and documentation standards
Conduct thorough testing and debugging of software components, resolving any issues or discrepancies.

Required Technical Skills

1st class Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
Fluency in C++ or C# for performance-critical systems
Proficiency in Python, especially for scripting, research integration, and data tools
Solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, and multithreaded/concurrent programming
Strong knowledge of SQL and modern database design (e.g., column stores, time-series DBs)
Familiarity with software engineering best practices: version control (Git), unit testing, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, etc.
Strong troubleshooting skills across distributed systems

Required Experience

3+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining high-performance trading systems, ideally in a systematic equities or quant trading environment
Proven experience in:
Handling large-scale market data (e.g., normalization, feed handling, replay systems)
Order routing and exchange connectivity, including FIX protocols and direct market access (DMA)
Building event-driven architectures and real-time systems with tight SLAs
Identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, or system instability in production environments

Highly Valued Relevant Attributes

Excellent communication skills - able to interface directly with quant researchers and traders, translate requirements, and explain technical decisions
Demonstrated initiative and ownership: able to drive projects independently, while collaborating effectively in a team setting
Comfortable in fast-paced, iterative environments where priorities can shift quickly based on market conditions or research insights
